https://leadership.ng/were-making-local-.body: He said that unlike before when only the economies in the city centres were working, he changed the narrative by laying the foundations and by embarking on enterprise and investing in the people, thus stimulating the local economies. Uzodimma spoke in Lagos as the guest lecturer at the inaugural National Policy Dialogue of the Lagos Country Club with Government Leaders. He said his administration long realised that a local economy that gives young people a stake in peace is among the best security investments a government can make, hence the foundation it has laid in the state. The governor noted that to attract private capital, the government must provide the basics, including infrastructure, human capital and power. The governor also said that with the state paying the highest minimum wage of N104,000, the economies of the local governments and rural communities have been boosted. “A well-paid public workforce is one of the quickest ways to put money into circulation at the grassroots,” he argued. He attributed the economic success recorded by the state to the reforms by President Bola Tinubu, saying that resources reaching the states have substantially increased since the president removed fuel subsidy. https://leadership.ng/tinubu-orders-secu.title: Tinubu Orders Security Crackdown On Political Thuggery
https://leadership.ng/tinubu-orders-secu.summary: The president also directed security agencies to confront thuggery and other anti-social and anti-democratic activities with full force. Tinubu gave the warning in a statement issued on Friday following reports of violence accompanying political events in different parts of the country.
https://leadership.ng/tinubu-orders-secu.summary_zh: 总统还指示安全机构全力打击暴徒行为以及其他反社会和反民主活动。蒂努布在星期五发表的一份声明中发出这一警告。此前有报道称，全国不同地区的政治活动伴随暴力事件。
https://leadership.ng/tinubu-orders-secu.body: The president also directed security agencies to confront thuggery and other anti-social and anti-democratic activities with full force. Tinubu gave the warning in a statement issued on Friday following reports of violence accompanying political events in different parts of the country. He condemned all forms of violence, saying political campaigns ahead of the 2027 elections should focus on issues and ideas that promote the welfare of Nigerians and national development. “Every form of violence stands condemned. Violence should never have a place in our political campaigns as we move toward the 2027 general elections,” he said. The president urged political leaders and their supporters across party lines to conduct themselves responsibly, stressing that political differences and competing ambitions should not turn Nigerians into enemies. He described Nigerians as members of the same household living in different rooms, adding that politics should be used to improve human conditions and advance national development. “As Nigerians, we are members of the same household living in different rooms. Therefore, our politics must elevate human conditions and focus on national progress and development,” Tinubu stated. Reiterating his directive to security agencies, the president said they must be strict and firm against anyone seeking to undermine public order. “I want to reiterate my previous directive to the security agencies: be strict and firm against anyone who seeks to test our resolve and will to preserve public order,” he said. Tinubu also assured political parties and candidates of protection, saying they must be allowed to campaign anywhere in the country without molestation or fear for their safety. “Our administration is committed to an orderly and peaceful election, and all political parties and candidates should be protected and free to campaign anywhere in the country without molestation or fear for their safety,” he added. The president further authorised security agencies to confront political thuggery and other anti-democratic activities with full force, warning that his administration would not tolerate irresponsible behaviour by politicians and their supporters. He reaffirmed his commitment to ensuring a peaceful, free and fair election in 2027. We’ve got the edge. Get real-time reports, breaking scoops, and exclusive angles delivered straight to your phone. Unlock these with Subscription Gurnoor Brar has been drafted into India’s Test squad for the New Zealand series, while Kuldeep Yadav has been released to play domestic cricket, with the team management opting to bolster the pace attack in favourable conditions. Rishabh Pant, the enigmatic wicketkeeper-batter, has joined the squad after recovering from back injury. The Hindu understands that the decision to bring in the lanky fast bowler was influenced by the friendly conditions expected during the Test series, which begins in Wellington on November 19. Brar has impressed during the ongoing ODI series and is expected to provide India with another seam-bowling option. The 26-year-old has been in New Zealand for well over three weeks. He had initially travelled as part of Test captain Shubman Gill’s personal bowling entourage before joining the ODI squad. Having spent considerable time acclimatising to the conditions, Brar will now link up with the Test contingent and will not be available for the fifth and final ODI. India has decided against naming a replacement for him. Pant had been recovering after hurting his back during the Irani Cup tie in the first week of October. Having proven his fitness and obtained clearance after featuring in a two-day match simulation in Bengaluru on November 10 and 11, Pant joined the Test squad in Wellington. Kuldeep, meanwhile, will return home after spending much of the tour on the sidelines. With the left-arm wrist-spinner unlikely to feature prominently in the team’s plans for the two Tests, the management and the selection committee felt that releasing him would allow him to get some much-needed game-time. The limited-overs leg of the domestic season got underway on Wednesday (November 11, 2026), giving Kuldeep an opportunity to get back into competitive action rather than remain on the bench in New Zealand. Wicketkeeper-batter Rishabh Pant has also joined the Indian squad in Wellington, adding to the team’s options ahead of the Test series. India’s updated 16-member Test squad will be led by Gill, with K.L. Rahul as vice-captain. Pant and Dhruv Jurel are the two wicketkeeping options, while Jasprit Bumrah, Mohammed Siraj, Prasidh Krishna, Akash Deep, Anshul Kamboj and Brar form the pace contingent. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: BEIJING — Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi elaborated on North Korean leader Kim Jong-un's recent visit to China during talks with his South Korean counterpart, a senior South Korean official said Saturday. The Chinese side explained Kim's trip to the Chinese border city of Dandong on Oct. 24 during Wang's talks with Foreign Minister Cho Hyun in Beijing on Friday, according to the foreign ministry official. "(The Chinese side) said that at a basic level, China's relations with North Korea are focused on economic cooperation rather than on political affairs," the official told reporters. "(We) were able to hear relatively detailed accounts." The official added the talks also touched on Wang's meeting with Kim Song-nam, a senior North Korean ruling party official, who visited Beijing last week. The official said the Chinese side also discussed the possibility of a U.S.-North Korea summit amid speculation over the possibility of renewed diplomacy between Washington and Pyongyang. "My impression (after the talks) was that while there is a possibility, it is not that big," the official said, noting that it would likely depend on the U.S. situation and U.S. President Donald Trump's willingness. During Friday's talks, Cho called on China to play a constructive role in resolving Korean Peninsula issues, including efforts to bring North Korea back to dialogue, according to Seoul's foreign ministry

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 北京——韩国一名高级官员周六表示，中国外交部长王毅在与韩国外交部长赵显烈会谈时，详细介绍了朝鲜领导人金正恩最近访华的行程。据外交部这名官员介绍，周五王毅在北京与赵显烈会谈时，中方解释了金正恩于10月24日到访中国边境城市丹东的行程。这名官员对记者说：“（中方）表示，从根本上说，中国与朝鲜的关系侧重于经济合作，而不是政治事务。”“（我们）听到了相当详细的说明。”这名官员补充说，会谈还谈到王毅会见朝鲜执政党高级官员金松南的情况，后者上周访问了北京。该官员说，在华盛顿与平壤可能重新开展外交的猜测之际，中方还讨论了举行美朝峰会的可能性。“我（会谈后）的印象是，虽然存在这种可能性，但并不大，”该官员说，并指出这可能取决于美国局势以及美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的意愿。据韩国外交部消息，在周五的会谈中，赵显烈呼吁中国在解决朝鲜半岛问题上发挥建设性作用，包括推动朝鲜重返对话。

https://moderndiplomacy.eu/2026/11/13/wh.summary: The Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum is preparing for one of its most closely watched gatherings, with US President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin expected to attend the leaders’ summit in Shenzhen, China. Although APEC does not operate as a formal political or security alliance, its annual leaders’ meeting provides an important platform for major powers to discuss economic relations, investment, supply chains and regional stability.
https://moderndiplomacy.eu/2026/11/13/wh.summary_zh: 亚太经济合作组织（APEC）正在筹备其最受关注的会议之一，预计美国总统唐纳德·特朗普、中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京将出席在中国深圳举行的领导人峰会。尽管APEC并非正式的政治或安全联盟，但其年度领导人会议为大国讨论经济关系、投资、供应链和地区稳定提供了重要平台。
https://moderndiplomacy.eu/2026/11/13/wh.body: The Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum is preparing for one of its most closely watched gatherings, with US President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin expected to attend the leaders’ summit in Shenzhen, China. The meeting comes as geopolitical tensions, trade disputes and conflicts affecting global energy markets place growing pressure on international economic cooperation. The 21-member forum brings together economies responsible for a substantial share of global output and trade. Although APEC does not operate as a formal political or security alliance, its annual leaders’ meeting provides an important platform for major powers to discuss economic relations, investment, supply chains and regional stability. Here are five key facts about APEC and the issues likely to shape this year’s summit. Founded in 1989 in Canberra, Australia, APEC began as an informal dialogue involving 12 economies. It has since developed into the Asia-Pacific region’s leading economic cooperation forum, promoting trade, investment, economic growth and regional integration. MD Briefing delivers expert analysis across five global fronts — the Indo-Pacific, energy, geoeconomics, European security, and the Middle East — every Monday morning. Free. The grouping’s 21 members account for approximately 62% of global GDP and around half of international trade, making it an important platform for discussions about the global economy. One distinctive feature is that APEC refers to its participants as “member economies” rather than countries. This arrangement allows both Hong Kong, which is governed by China, and Taiwan, which Beijing claims as part of its territory, to participate under their respective designations. However, India, despite being the world’s most populous country, is not a member. APEC also operates differently from organisations that impose legally binding obligations on their members. Its decisions are reached through consensus, and commitments are voluntary and non-binding. This allows economies with different political systems and strategic interests to participate without accepting a common set of enforceable economic rules. China is hosting APEC for the third time, following previous summits in Shanghai in 2001 and Beijing in 2014. This year’s choice of Shenzhen carries both economic and strategic significance. Located close to Hong Kong, Shenzhen is part of China’s Greater Bay Area, which also includes Macau. Beijing aims to develop the region into a major international centre for technology, finance and innovation. The city is also home to some of China’s most prominent technology and manufacturing companies, including BYD, Huawei and Tencent. Its economic transformation from a relatively small settlement into a major technology and industrial centre makes it an important showcase for China’s development model. Chim Lee, a senior analyst at the Economist Intelligence Unit, said the choice reflects both domestic and international considerations. Shenzhen provides China with an opportunity to highlight its technological capabilities, trade ambitions and resilience amid geopolitical uncertainty. Hosting the summit in the city also allows Beijing to present its vision of the Greater Bay Area as an increasingly important centre of global economic activity. The presence of several major world leaders is expected to make this year’s meeting particularly significant. Chinese President Xi Jinping is set to chair the leaders’ meeting and deliver remarks. US President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin are also among the expected participants, creating the possibility of high-level discussions involving three major powers. Other expected attendees include Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and the leaders of Canada, Australia, Mexico, Indonesia, Malaysia, South Korea and Vietnam. Taiwan has designated Stan Shih, founder of Acer, as its representative. Japan has not formally confirmed whether Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi will attend, while New Zealand has yet to officially announce its delegation. The potential participation of Trump, Xi and Putin will attract particular attention because their countries have overlapping economic interests but sharply different positions on trade, security and international conflicts. However, the presence of leaders at the same summit does not necessarily mean that formal bilateral or trilateral agreements will follow. Several geopolitical and economic disputes are expected to shape discussions in Shenzhen. The economic consequences of conflict in the Middle East are likely to feature prominently. Disruptions to energy supplies and shipping routes can affect global trade, supply chains and inflation, creating challenges for economies that depend heavily on imported energy. For APEC members, the issue is particularly important because economic growth across the region remains closely connected to international trade and reliable energy supplies. The possible presence of all three leaders places their diplomatic interactions among the summit’s main points of interest. China has shown reluctance to participate in nuclear disarmament discussions, partly because its nuclear arsenal is smaller than those of the United States and Russia. Washington and Moscow may also seek to discuss the war in Ukraine, although their respective positions on China could differ. The summit could therefore provide opportunities for diplomatic contact, even if the leaders do not reach substantive agreements. Relations between Washington and Beijing will be another major focus. Both sides are facing difficulties in meeting commitments associated with an extended trade truce, according to analysts. Rare earth supplies, artificial intelligence, tariffs and technology restrictions are likely to remain important areas of disagreement. US arms sales to Taiwan will also be closely watched, given Beijing’s strong opposition to military cooperation between Washington and Taipei. These issues extend beyond bilateral trade. They affect global manufacturing, technology supply chains and the ability of businesses to operate across major markets. Regional security tensions will also influence the summit’s diplomatic environment. Relations between China and Japan have remained strained since November 2025, when Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi suggested that Japan could deploy its military if Chinese action against Taiwan also threatened Japanese territory. Beijing strongly objected to her remarks. China’s relationship with the Philippines is also under pressure because of continuing disputes in the South China Sea. These tensions involve maritime claims and competing interests over access to strategically important waters. The participation of both countries’ leaders could provide an opportunity for diplomatic engagement, although the underlying disputes remain unresolved. APEC consists of 21 member economies spanning the Asia-Pacific region: The diversity of its membership is one of APEC’s defining characteristics. It brings together advanced industrial economies, emerging markets and developing economies, allowing discussions on trade and investment across a broad geographical and economic landscape. The APEC leaders’ meeting is scheduled for November 18 and 19, preceded by an annual CEO summit on November 17 and 18. The discussions will take place against a backdrop of trade uncertainty, geopolitical competition and concerns about the resilience of international supply chains. The gathering’s significance will depend not only on the declarations issued by its members but also on whether major economies can maintain dialogue despite their differences. For China, hosting the summit offers an opportunity to demonstrate its economic influence and present Shenzhen as a centre of technological development. For the United States, Russia and other participants, the meeting provides a platform to engage with key regional economies while navigating competing strategic priorities. APEC’s consensus-based and non-binding structure limits its ability to resolve major geopolitical disputes. Nevertheless, its economic reach makes it an important venue for maintaining communication among powers whose decisions have consequences well beyond the Asia-Pacific region. https://moderndiplomacy.eu/2026/11/13/wh.title_zh: 在特朗普、习近平和普京筹备重要亚太峰会之际，亚太经合组织为何重要？
https://moderndiplomacy.eu/2026/11/13/wh.body_zh: 亚太经济合作组织（APEC）论坛正筹备最受关注的会议之一，预计美国总统唐纳德·特朗普、中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京将出席在中国深圳举行的领导人峰会。此次会议召开之际，地缘政治紧张、贸易争端以及影响全球能源市场的冲突，正给国际经济合作带来日益增大的压力。这个拥有21个成员的经济体论坛汇聚了贡献全球产出和贸易相当大份额的经济体。尽管APEC并非正式的政治或安全联盟，但其年度领导人会议为大国讨论经济关系、投资、供应链和地区稳定提供了重要平台。以下是有关APEC以及可能影响今年峰会议题的五项关键事实。APEC于1989年在澳大利亚堪培拉成立，最初是12个经济体参与的非正式对话。此后，它已发展成为亚太地区主要的 经济合作论坛，推动贸易、投资、经济增长和区域一体化。MD Briefing每周一上午从五个全球领域——印太、能源、地缘经济、欧洲安全和中东——提供专家分析，免费订阅。该组织21个成员约占全球GDP的62%，并占国际贸易的一半左右，因此成为讨论全球经济的重要平台。其一大特色是，APEC称参与者为“成员经济体”，而非国家。这一安排使由中国管辖的香港，以及北京声称属于其领土一部分的台湾，均能以各自名称参与。然而，印度尽管是世界上人口最多的国家，却不是成员。APEC的运作方式也不同于对成员施加法律约束义务的组织。其决策通过共识达成，承诺属于自愿且不具约束力。这使政治制度和战略利益不同的经济体能够在不接受一套可强制执行的经济规则的情况下参与。中国是第三次承办APEC，此前分别于2001年和2014年在上海和北京举行过峰会。今年选择深圳，兼具经济和战略意义。深圳毗邻香港，是中国大湾区的一部分，大湾区还包括澳门。北京希望将该地区发展成为重要的国际科技、金融和创新中心。这座城市也是中国一些最知名的科技和制造企业所在地，包括比亚迪、华为和腾讯。它从相对较小的聚落转型为重要科技和工业中心，这一经济蜕变使其成为中国发展模式的重要展示窗口。《经济学人》智库高级分析师Chim Lee表示，选择深圳体现了国内和国际两方面考量。深圳为中国提供了展示技术能力、贸易雄心和在地缘政治不确定性中韧性的机会。在该市举办峰会，也让北京得以展示其大湾区愿景，将其定位为日益重要的全球经济活动中心。全球多位主要领导人预计将出席，使今年的会议格外重要。中国国家主席习近平将主持领导人会议并发表讲话。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京也在预计出席者之列，由此可能出现涉及三个大国的 高层讨论。其他预计出席者包括菲律宾总统费迪南德·马科斯 Jr.，以及加拿大、澳大利亚、墨西哥、印度尼西亚、马来西亚、韩国和越南领导人。台湾已指定宏碁创始人施振荣作为代表。日本尚未正式确认首相高市早苗是否出席，新西兰也尚未正式宣布其代表团。特朗普、习近平和普京可能与会，将尤其引人关注，因为三国在经济利益上存在重叠，但在贸易、安全和国际冲突问题上的立场差异鲜明。然而，领导人同时出席同一次峰会，并不必然意味着随后会达成正式的双边或三边协议。预计将有几项地缘政治和经济争端影响深圳的讨论。中东冲突造成的经济后果很可能成为突出议题。能源供应和航运路线中断会影响全球贸易、供应链和通胀，给高度依赖进口能源的经济体带来挑战。对APEC成员而言，这一议题尤为重要，因为该地区的经济增长仍与国际贸易和可靠的能源供应紧密相连。三位领导人可能同时在场，使他们的外交互动成为峰会主要看点之一。中国一直不愿参与核裁军讨论，部分原因是其核武库规模小于美国和俄罗斯。华盛顿和莫斯科也可能寻求讨论乌克兰战争，尽管双方各自对中国的立场可能不同。因此，即便领导人未能达成实质性协议，峰会仍可能为外交接触提供机会。华盛顿与北京的关系将是另一主要焦点。分析人士指出，双方在履行延长贸易休战承诺方面都面临困难。稀土供应、人工智能、关税和技术限制仍可能是重要分歧领域。美国对台湾的军售也将受到密切审视，原因是北京强烈反对华盛顿与台北之间的军事合作。这些问题不局限于双边贸易，而是影响全球制造业、科技供应链以及企业跨主要市场运营的能力。地区安全紧张也将影响峰会的外交环境。自2025年11月以来，中日关系一直紧张。当时，日本首相高市早苗表示，如果中国针对台湾的行动也威胁日本领土，日本可以部署军队。北京对她的言论提出强烈异议。由于南海争端持续不断，中国与菲律宾的关系也承受压力。这些紧张局势涉及海洋主张，以及各国对进入具有战略意义水域的竞争性利益。两国领导人共同参会可能为外交接触提供机会，但根本争端仍未解决。APEC由横跨亚太地区的21个成员经济体组成，其成员多样性是APEC的定义性特征之一。它将发达工业经济体、新兴市场和发展中经济体汇聚在一起，使各方能够在广阔的地理和经济范围内讨论贸易与投资。APEC领导人会议定于11月18日和19日举行，在此之前，年度首席执行官峰会将于11月17日和18日举行。各方将在贸易前景不明、地缘政治竞争以及国际供应链韧性受到担忧的背景下展开讨论。此次会议的重要性不仅取决于成员发布的宣言，也取决于主要经济体能否在存在分歧的情况下继续对话。对中国而言，承办峰会有助于展示经济影响力，并将深圳塑造成科技发展中心。对美国、俄罗斯和其他参与方而言，本次会议提供了一个在权衡相互冲突的战略优先事项的同时，与关键地区经济体交流的平台。APEC以共识为基础且不具约束力的结构，限制了其解决重大地缘政治争端的能力。尽管如此，其经济覆盖面使其成为维持各国沟通的重要场所，而这些国家的决策所产生的影响远超亚太地区。MD不支持任何特定议程、叙事或思想流派。我们旨在让所有观点、 thinkers 和论点接受审视，并辨明其中哪些仍然有效且站得住脚

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: PYEONGTAEK, Gyeonggi Province — More than seven decades after the 1950-53 Korean War, a group of Korean veterans returned to a U.S. Army base where they once served — this time as honored guests of a new generation of American soldiers. “It feels like coming home,” said Kang Ku-kon, who was 15 when he volunteered and began helping care for wounded American soldiers at an Eighth Army field hospital. “I served here 70 years ago. The moment I walked in, even the smell was the same.” Kang was among a group of Korean War veterans welcomed to Camp Humphreys in Pyeongtaek, Gyeonggi Province, on Nov. 5. As their bus arrived at the Van Fleet Hall, a U.S. Army band began playing. For many of the visitors, now in their 90s, the trip offered a chance to see a place tied to their wartime service and meet the soldiers stationed there today. The visit grew out of a request from the veterans themselves. Vice Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs Kang Yun-jin said several veterans, including Ryu Jae-sik, head of the Korean War Veterans Association’s Seoul branch, raised the idea at a memorial event in Seoul attended by former U.S. military commanders and the ministry helped arrange the trip. “It was moving to see Eighth Army soldiers welcome our Korean War veterans with applause,” Kang said during the ceremony. “I am grateful to everyone who made this visit possible.” Lt. Gen. Joseph Hilbert, commander of the Eighth Army, paid tribute to the veterans for their service during the war. “The peace, prosperity and vibrant democracy we see across the Republic of Korea today did not happen by accident,” Hilbert said. “It was not guaranteed, but it was bought by and paid for by your courage, your sweat and your blood.” Departing from his prepared remarks, Hilbert said the sight of Seoul still reminded him of those who fought to defend the country. Every time he flies over the capital in a helicopter heading north, he said, he thinks of their sacrifice and what it made possible. The veterans then toured the headquarters, where photographs of those who fought in the Korean War line the walls. Some stopped when they recognized themselves or their comrades in the old pictures. One veteran pointed out a familiar face, prompting others to gather around. Several veterans then posed with Vice Minister Kang Yun-jin in front of the photographs, recreating the poses captured decades earlier. Hilbert wanted them to know that the display was not arranged for the occasion. “We didn’t put those pictures up for your visit,” he told them. “They’re here every day.” He said soldiers walking those corridors see the faces of the men who came before them, a daily reminder of the responsibility they carry. For Kang, the welcome brought back his years alongside American troops. He said he had come expecting to express his gratitude to the U.S. soldiers who helped defend South Korea, not to be thanked himself. “We should be the ones welcoming them, but instead they’re welcoming us,” he said. “I’m grateful.” Ryu, who enlisted at 18 and fought on the front lines, had a similar message. On the bus to Camp Humphreys, he urged his fellow veterans to remember the Americans who died or were wounded in the war and to see how today’s U.S. troops carry on their mission in Korea. The formal welcome was over, but an unexpected encounter awaited the veterans. While touring the base museum, the veterans came across a group of Korean noncommissioned officers (NCOs) taking part in a professional development program at the Army Special Warfare School. The younger soldiers saluted the veterans, then gathered with them for photographs. The two groups met again as the veterans prepared to leave. The NCOs stood on either side of the departing vehicle and saluted
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 京畿道平泽——在1950年至1953年朝鲜战争结束70多年后，一组朝鲜战争老兵重返他们曾服役的美国陆军基地，而这一次，他们是新一代美国士兵的贵宾。15岁时应征入伍、开始在第八集团军野战医院协助照料伤员的美国兵的姜九功说：“感觉就像回家一样。70年前，我曾在这里服役。我走进去的那一刻，连气味都一模一样。”11月5日，姜九功是受到欢迎、来到京畿道平泽 Humphreys 营地的朝鲜战争老兵之一。巴士抵达 Van Fleet Hall 时，美国陆军军乐队开始奏乐。对许多如今已年逾90岁的来访者而言，此行让他们有机会看看与战时服役经历紧密相连的地方，并与驻扎在那里的当今士兵见面。这次访问源于老兵们自己的请求。祖国及退伍军人事务部副部长姜允镇说，包括朝鲜战争退伍军人协会首尔分会会长柳在锡在内的数名老兵，在首尔参加有美国前军事指挥官出席的纪念活动时提出了这一想法，随后该部协助安排了此次旅行。姜允镇在仪式上表示：“看到第八集团军士兵以掌声欢迎我们的朝鲜战争老兵，令人十分感动。我感谢所有促成这次访问的人。”第八集团军司令约瑟夫·希尔伯特中将向老兵们致敬，表彰他们在战争期间的服役经历。希尔伯特说：“我们今天在韩国看到的和平、繁荣和充满活力的民主并非偶然。它并非唾手可得，而是用你们的勇气、汗水和鲜血换来的，并用生命付出了代价。”希尔伯特在准备好的讲话之外还说，每次看到首尔，他仍会想起那些为保卫这个国家而战斗的人。他说，每当乘直升机向北飞越首都时，他都会想起他们的牺牲，以及这种牺牲所促成的成果。随后，老兵们参观了司令部，墙上陈列着参加朝鲜战争者的照片。有些人在旧照片中认出自己或战友后停了下来。一名老兵指出一张熟悉的面孔，其他人随即围拢过来。数名老兵接着在照片前与副部长姜允镇合影，重现数十年前镜头中记录的姿态。希尔伯特希望他们知道，这些照片并非为了此次访问才布置出来。他告诉他们：“我们并不是为了你们来访才挂上这些照片的。它们每天都在这里。”他说，士兵们走过那些走廊时，会看到前辈们的面孔，这每天都提醒着他们肩负的责任。对姜九功而言，这次欢迎让他想起与美军并肩作战的岁月。他说，自己原本是来向帮助保卫韩国的美国士兵表达感谢，而不是来接受他们的感谢。他说：“应该由我们欢迎他们，但最后是他们欢迎我们。我深感感激。”18岁入伍并在前线作战的柳在锡也expressed类似的心声。在前往 Humphreys 营地的巴士上，他敦促 fellow veterans 铭记在战争中阵亡或负伤的美国人，并看看今天的美国军队如何继续在韩国履行使命。正式欢迎仪式结束后，老兵们还意外迎来了一次相遇。参观基地博物馆时，他们遇到一群正在陆军特种作战学校参加专业发展项目的韩国士官。年轻士兵向老兵敬礼，随后与他们一起合影。老兵准备离开时，双方再次相遇。士官们站在即将驶离的车辆两侧敬礼……

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: WASHINGTON — U.S. President Donald Trump seems to view an envisioned transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON) to South Korea as a potential means of withdrawing American troops from the Korean Peninsula, U.S. experts assessed Friday. Victor Cha, Korea chair at the Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS), made the remarks during an online discussion hosted by the Washington-based think tank on the state of the South Korea-U.S. alliance. "It has been said, and I think said very credibly, that President Trump sees OPCON transition as a way to pull the forces from the peninsula," Cha said. "The president is the commander in chief," he said. "There are ways that the president can do things if he is so committed to that particular task." Cha said that even if Congress established a minimum level of U.S. troops in South Korea through the National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA), Trump could still find ways to reduce the American military presence. "They should have no illusions that this is not the way the U.S. president thinks," he said. "He clearly sees this as a way for him to remove troops from the peninsula." Randall Schriver, a former assistant secretary of defense for Indo-Pacific security affairs, echoed Cha's view, saying Trump has long expressed a desire to reduce the U.S. military footprint in South Korea. "I 100 percent agree that the potential for him to view OPCON transfer as a way out or a way to reduce (U.S. troops in Korea) is there," Schriver said. Schriver expressed hope that any move toward the transfer would allow sufficient time for deliberations involving the Pentagon, military leaders and Congress over the benefits of maintaining the U.S. military presence in South Korea. Vincent Brooks, a former commander of U.S. Forces Korea, meanwhile, expressed disappointment over South Korean Defense Minister Kang Shin-chul's earlier endorsement of an assessment that Seoul could defend itself without major difficulties even if wartime OPCON were transferred immediately. "I was very disappointed that the South Korean minister of defense, whom I know very well, general and now Minister Kang Shin-chul, said it could happen today," Brooks said. "Well, that's kind of true. It could if there's a political decision, but if I'm a college student, I can say I could graduate today, even if I haven't taken the requisite courses and passed the final exam," he said. Brooks stressed that the transfer should proceed only after the allies fulfill mutually agreed conditions, rather than simply through a political decision. Kang, then defense minister nominee, said in a written response to a parliamentary inquiry in September that he agreed with then-Defense Minister Ahn Gyu-back's assessment that South Korea would have no major difficulty defending itself even if wartime OPCON were returned the following day. He, however, stressed that mutual trust in the South Korea-U.S. alliance must be guaranteed
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 专家：特朗普可能将OPCON移交视为美军撤离的途径
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 华盛顿——美国专家上周五评估称，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普似乎将设想中的战时作战指挥权（OPCON）移交给韩国视为从朝鲜半岛撤出美国 troops的一种可能方式。战略与国际问题研究中心（CSIS）韩国研究主席维克托·查在由这家总部位于华盛顿的智库主办的一次关于韩美同盟状况的线上讨论中发表了上述言论。查说：“有人说过，而且我认为说得非常可信，特朗普总统将OPCON移交视为从半岛撤军的一种方式。总统是武装部队总司令。如果他坚定地致力于那项特定任务，总统会有办法采取行动。”查说，即使国会通过《国防授权法》（NDAA）规定驻韩美军的最低人数，特朗普仍可能找到办法削减美国在当地的军事存在。他说：“他们不应抱有任何幻想，认为这并非美国总统的想法。他显然将此举视为从半岛撤军的一种方式。”曾任负责印太安全事务的助理国防部长兰德尔·施赖弗赞同查的看法，称特朗普长期以来都表达了削减美国在韩国军事存在的愿望。施赖弗说：“我百分之百同意，他有可能将OPCON移交视为退出韩国的途径，或是削减（驻韩美军）的一种方式。”施赖弗希望，任何推动移交的举措都能留出充足时间，让五角大楼、军方领导人和国会共同审议继续在韩国维持美国军事存在的好处。与此同时，曾任驻韩美军司令的文森特·布鲁克斯对韩国国防部长姜善卓此前认可的一项评估表示失望。该评估认为，即使立即移交战时OPCON，首尔也能够毫无重大困难地保卫自己。布鲁克斯说：“我对接韩国国防部长非常失望，我很熟悉他——姜善卓将军，如今担任国防部长——但他说这件事今天就能做到。嗯，这话某种程度上确实没错。如果政治上作出决定，这可以成为现实；但如果我是一名大学生，我也可以说自己今天就能毕业，即使我并未修完规定课程、也没有通过期末考试。”布鲁克斯强调，只有在盟国满足双方商定的条件后，移交才应推进，而不应仅凭一项政治决定就予实施。时任国防部长提名人姜在9月对一项议会质询的书面答复中说，他同意时任国防部长安圭伯对相关评估的看法，即即使次日即归还战时OPCON，韩国在保卫自身方面也不会遇到重大困难。不过，他强调，必须保障韩美同盟之间的相互信任

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 京畿道平泽——当一批朝鲜战争退伍军人于11月参观 Humphreys 军营时。然而，对于仍在世的大约2万名参加1950年至1953年战争的朝鲜战争老兵——如今平均年龄为94岁——更为紧迫的问题是，政府能否在他们剩余的岁月里提供充分照护、医疗支持和经济援助。康还表示，除了这样的场合之外，政府必须优先确保退伍军人在世期间获得适当照护和认可。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: PYEONGTAEK, Gyeonggi Province — When a group of Korean War veterans visited Camp Humphreys on Nov. 5, the emotional meeting with a new generation of American soldiers offered a rare moment of recognition. However, for the roughly 20,000 Korean veterans of the 1950-53 war still living — now averaging 94 years old — the more urgent question is whether the government can provide adequate care, medical support and financial assistance in their remaining years. Vice Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs Kang Yun-jin, who accompanied them, said the visit brought back memories of her earlier work promoting exchanges between Korean and American veterans. Watching the veterans receive a warm welcome from U.S. soldiers was particularly moving, she said. But beyond such occasions, Kang said the government’s priority must be ensuring that veterans receive proper care and recognition while they are still alive. “What matters most is ensuring that veterans can spend their remaining years in good health and comfort, with the pride and honor they deserve for their service to the country,” Kang told The Korea Times. The ministry is working to improve financial support, medical care and assistance with daily life for aging veterans. The government has proposed raising the monthly allowance for war veterans by 50,000 won ($38), from 490,000 won this year to 540,000 won in 2027. If approved, it would be the largest increase since 2018. Financial assistance for low-income veterans was also extended in March to include surviving spouses. The ministry is seeking to expand its network of designated hospitals from 1,117 to 2,000 by 2030, allowing veterans to receive treatment closer to home. It is also upgrading medical facilities at existing veterans hospitals. For elderly veterans living alone, the government provides home-care services and has introduced an artificial intelligence-assisted monitoring system that uses phone activity and door sensors to detect potential emergencies. Kang recalled a conversation with a Korean War veteran she met while helping serve meals at a veterans’ event. “We defended our country when it was in trouble. Now we ask our country to protect us,” the veteran told her. “We will do our utmost to ensure that veterans can live with dignity until the very end of their lives,” she said. Beyond providing care, the ministry is working to preserve veterans’ firsthand accounts of the war as their numbers continue to decline. “Veterans’ experiences and testimonies are invaluable to understanding Korea’s history and the importance of freedom and peace,” Kang said. The ministry operates a digital archive containing interviews, personal records and other materials from veterans from countries that fought in the Korean War under the U.N. Command. As of July, the archive contained 514 interviews. The materials are used in school lessons and educational programs, while a separate initiative connects Korean schools with those in countries that sent troops during the war. Kang said younger generations should remember that the veterans they see today were once teenagers and young adults. “The veterans here today were young people themselves more than 70 years ago, no different from today’s generation,” she said. Among those visiting Camp Humphreys was Ryu Jae-sik, who enlisted at 18 and fought on the front lines, and Kang Ku-kon, who volunteered at 15 and helped care for wounded American soldiers at an Eighth Army field hospital
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 随着仅剩20,000名朝鲜战争老兵仍在世，政府加大努力保存他们的故事
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 京畿道平泽——11月5日，一批朝鲜战争老兵参观 Humphreys 军营时，与新一代美国士兵的感人相聚带来了一次难得的认可时刻。然而，对于仍在世的大约2万名1950年至1953年战争朝鲜老兵而言——他们如今平均年龄已达94岁——更为紧迫的问题是，政府能否在他们的有生之年提供充分的照护、医疗支持和经济援助。陪同他们来访的韩国退役军人与荣军事务副部长姜允真说，此次参访唤起了她此前推动韩美退役军人交流工作的回忆。她说，看到老兵们受到美国士兵热烈欢迎，尤其令人动容。但姜允真表示，除了这样的场合，政府工作的重点必须是确保老兵在世期间获得妥善照护和尊重。她对《韩国时报》说：“最重要的是确保老兵们能够以健康、舒适的状态度过余生，并因他们为国家作出的贡献而享有应有的自豪与荣誉。”该部门正在努力改善对年迈老兵的经济支持、医疗照护和日常生活援助。政府提议将战争老兵的月度津贴提高50,000韩元（38美元），从今年的490,000韩元提高到2027年的540,000韩元。如获批准，这将是2018年以来幅度最大的一次上调。针对低收入老兵的经济援助也已于3月延长至涵盖遗孀。该部门计划到2030年将指定医院网络从1,117家扩大到2,000家，使老兵能够在离家更近的地方接受治疗，同时也在升级现有老兵医院的医疗设施。对于独居的年迈老兵，政府提供居家照护服务，并引入了一套人工智能辅助监测系统，利用电话活动记录和门传感器发现潜在紧急情况。姜允真回忆起，她在一场老兵活动中协助供餐时，曾与一位朝鲜战争老兵交谈。那位老兵对她说：“国家陷入危难时，我们曾保卫自己的国家。现在，我们请求国家保护我们。”她说：“我们将尽最大努力，确保老兵们能够有尊严地生活，直至生命的最后一刻。”除了提供照护，该部门还在随着老兵人数持续减少而 efforts 保存他们的亲历叙述。姜允真说：“老兵的经历和证言对于理解韩国历史以及自由与和平的重要性而言，具有不可估量的价值。”该部门运营着一个数字档案库，收藏曾在联合国军旗下参加朝鲜战争的各国老兵的访谈、个人记录及其他资料。截至7月，档案库已收录514份访谈。这些材料被用于学校课程和教育项目，另有了一项独立计划，将韩国学校与战争期间派兵国家的学校连接起来。姜允真说，年轻一代应当记住，如今他们所见的老兵，曾经也是十几岁的少年和青年。她说：“今天在场的这些老兵，70多年前 themselves 也是年轻人，与今天的这一代人并无不同。”前来参观 Humphreys 军营的人中，有18岁入伍并在前线作战的柳在植，也有15岁自愿参军并在第八集团军野战医院协助照护受伤美国士兵的姜九宪……

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title: Antitrust fines to hit brokerage, bank earnings but leave capital buffers intact: KIS report
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: Korea’s largest-ever antitrust fine will cut into this year’s earnings at the brokerages and banks that underwrite government debt, but it is unlikely to weaken their capital buffers, according to Korea Investors Service (KIS), a Moody’s affiliate. It added that their capital strength and the earnings they built up in the first half should be enough to absorb the cost, creating a formidable yet manageable financial hurdle for the country's primary financial institutions.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 韩国史上规模最大的反垄断罚款将侵蚀承销政府债务的券商和银行今年的盈利，但据穆迪旗下机构韩国投资服务公司（KIS）称，这不太可能削弱它们的资本缓冲。该公司补充说，这些机构的资本实力以及上半年积累的盈利应足以承担相关成本，从而为该国主要金融机构设置一道艰巨但可控的财务难关。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Record penalties expected to squeeze second-half profits Editor’s note This article is part of a series utilizing data and reports provided by Korea Investors Service (KIS) to offer our readers in-depth insights on industry trends, corporate fiscal health and M&A deals. Korea’s largest-ever antitrust fine will cut into this year’s earnings at the brokerages and banks that underwrite government debt, but it is unlikely to weaken their capital buffers, according to Korea Investors Service (KIS), a Moody’s affiliate. In a report released earlier this week, the credit rating agency said the penalties imposed by the Korea Fair Trade Commission (FTC) will make “a short-term decline in profitability unavoidable,” especially at the firms facing the largest penalties. It added that their capital strength and the earnings they built up in the first half should be enough to absorb the cost, creating a formidable yet manageable financial hurdle for the country's primary financial institutions. The regulatory crackdown stems from an investigation into primary dealers in Korea's sovereign debt market. The FTC issued corrective orders on Wednesday and imposed roughly 1.6 trillion won ($1.2 billion) in combined fines on 15 financial institutions — all designated primary dealers responsible for underwriting Korea Treasury bonds — for restricting competition over a span of roughly three and a half years, from January 2020 through June 2023. The FTC said the 15 firms agreed on bid rates and volumes or exchanged sensitive bid-rate information before taking part in competitive auctions for Korea Treasury bonds. It classified the conduct as two types of collusion under the Monopoly Regulation and Fair Trade Act: information-exchange collusion and bid rigging. According to KIS, the regulator calculated the fines by applying a 4.5 percent rate to about 54 trillion won in sales it judged were affected by the collusion, then adjusted each firm’s amount for individual factors. In addition to the financial penalties, the regulator decided to refer seven institutions with longer periods of involvement and higher numbers of collusive bids to prosecutors for criminal investigation. Individual penalties vary widely across the 15 institutions, ranging from 3.9 billion won to 332.2 billion won, with the securities industry bearing the brunt of the bill. Ten brokerages were hit with the lion's share of the total, led by KB Securities with the largest single penalty at 332.2 billion won. It was followed by NH Investment & Securities at 242.8 billion won, Mirae Asset Securities at 214.8 billion won, Shinhan Securities at 147.3 billion won, Daishin Securities at 120.1 billion won, Samsung Securities at 118.9 billion won, Kiwoom Securities at 83.8 billion won, Meritz Securities at 64.6 billion won, Korea Investment & Securities at 37.9 billion won and Kyobo Securities at 13.7 billion won. Industry risk: limited. For credit analysts, the key variables now are how much of each fine is booked and when, whether appeals succeed in reducing the amounts, when cash actually leaves the firms and how capital ratios change in the second half. KIS also flagged reputational and internal-control risks that could indirectly weaken the firms’ business bases and credibility. Key player profiles: KB Securities faces the heaviest burden. Its 332.2 billion won fine equals 4.2 percent of its equity and 54.2 percent of its 2025 net profit, and it was referred to prosecutors. It booked the entire amount as a provision in its preliminary third-quarter results. NH Investment & Securities’ 242.8 billion won fine is 2.5 percent of its equity and 26.7 percent of last year’s net profit. It was referred to prosecutors. Mirae Asset Securities’ 214.8 billion won fine is 2.0 percent of its equity and 36.1 percent of its 2025 profit. It was also referred to prosecutors. Shinhan Securities’ fine of 147.3 billion won is 2.5 percent of its equity, but it equals 41 percent of its 2025 net profit, the third-highest share among the 15 firms. Daishin Securities’ 120.1 billion won fine is 2.6 percent of its equity, the second-highest ratio after KB Securities, and 25.3 percent of its 2025 profit. Industrial Bank of Korea received the largest fine among the banks at 135.8 billion won. That is only 0.4 percent of its equity and 5.7 percent of its 2025 profit. It was referred to prosecutors, as was Korea Development Bank. The timing of the penalties poses an immediate hurdle for corporate balance sheets. KIS noted that while the exact timing of when each institution records the expense depends on its internal accounting judgments, most firms are expected to recognize the provisions in the third or fourth quarter now that the FTC’s ruling has specified exact amounts. KB Securities has already booked its 332.2 billion won fine in full as a provision in its third-quarter preliminary earnings disclosure. “As a result, 2026 profitability could fall considerably, centered on the financial institutions facing large fines,” the rating agency said. The timing compounds existing operational headwinds. KIS pointed out that the broader operating environment for securities houses is turning less favorable in the second half of the year, meaning that massive provisions will place acute downward pressure on annual net income. Despite the severity of the earnings squeeze, KIS drew a clear line between profitability and capital soundness. Because the fines represent between 0.0 percent and 4.2 percent of each firm’s equity, the agency concluded that the direct impact on capital adequacy should generally be limited. Major brokerages serving as primary dealers maintain relatively strong capital bases and solid business foundations. Furthermore, strong operating performance through the first half of 2026 left these firms with a healthy cushion of earnings, enabling them to absorb the regulatory charges without destabilizing their capital adequacy. The banking sector faces even lighter exposure relative to its size. With the exception of IBK, whose penalty equals 0.4 percent of its equity and 5.7 percent of its 2025 net profit, none of the sanctioned banks face fines exceeding 0.1 percent of equity or 3.6 percent of last year’s net profit. Primary dealer: A financial institution licensed by the government to underwrite and trade Treasury bonds, with an obligation to take part in auctions and make markets in government debt. There are 20 now, and there were 18 during the period covered by the case. They are required to bid in Treasury auctions and make markets in government debt, which makes them central to how the state funds itself. Bid rigging: An agreement among bidders on the prices, here interest rates, or quantities they will submit in an auction, which limits competition. Information-exchange collusion: Sharing competitively sensitive information, such as planned bid rates, with rivals in a way that restricts competition even without an explicit price agreement. Affected sales: The revenue a regulator judges was influenced by illegal conduct, used as the base for calculating fines. Provision: An amount a company books as an expense for a likely future payment whose size can be reliably estimated, which reduces profit when it is recorded. Capital adequacy: How much capital a financial firm holds relative to its risks, which measures its ability to absorb losses. Stay of execution: A court order suspending enforcement of an administrative measure, such as a fine payment, while a lawsuit is pending. The sanctioned financial institutions are expected to review the FTC’s written decision and potentially file formal objections or administrative lawsuits to overturn the fines. KIS anticipates that defense strategies will scrutinize individual participation across specific auctions, the duration of violations, the calculation of affected sales and the appropriateness of the fine-computation methodology — particularly by distinguishing between auctions involving concrete agreements on rates and volumes versus those involving only information exchanges. Filing a lawsuit, however, does not automatically suspend the legal obligation to pay. KIS noted that firms may apply for a stay of execution, extended payment deadlines or installment plans alongside their appeals. If a stay is not granted, firms could be forced to pay the fines while litigation is still pending, triggering immediate cash outflows. While a stay or installment arrangement would delay or spread out liquidity burdens, firms will still take an immediate profit-and-loss hit once accounting criteria for recognizing provisions are met. Moving forward, KIS said it will closely monitor the actual scale and timing of provisions booked by each firm, the progress of legal appeals and any adjustments to final penalties, funding burdens from fine payments and second-half earnings and capital ratios. The FTC fined 15 primary dealers a record 1.63 trillion won for rigging Treasury bond auctions between 2020 and 2023. KIS expects the fines to sharply reduce 2026 profits at the hardest-hit firms, led by KB Securities, NH Investment & Securities and Mirae Asset Securities. Because the penalties equal no more than 4.2 percent of any firm’s equity, the agency sees limited direct damage to capital adequacy. Appeals are likely, but cash outflows may come first unless courts suspend payment. This article was published with the assistance of generative AI and edited by The Korea Times
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: KIS报告：反垄断罚款将影响券商和银行业绩，但资本缓冲仍保持完整
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh:
罚单预计将挤压下半年利润

编者按：本文是系列报道之一，利用Korea Investors Service（KIS，韩国投资者服务）提供的数据和报告，为读者深入解读行业趋势、企业财务状况和并购交易。

据Moody’s旗下机构Korea Investors Service（KIS）称，韩国史上金额最大的反垄断罚款将侵蚀今年承销政府债务的证券公司和银行的盈利，但不太可能削弱这些机构的资本缓冲。KIS在本周早些时候发布的报告中表示，韩国公平交易委员会（FTC）实施的罚款将令“短期盈利下降不可避免”，尤其是面临最高罚款的企业。报告还称，这些机构的资本实力和上半年积累的盈利应足以消化相关成本，从而给韩国主要金融机构造成一项严峻但可控的财务考验。

这场监管整顿源于对韩国主权债务市场一级交易商的调查。FTC于周三发布纠正命令，对15家金融机构处以合计约1.6万亿韩元（12亿美元）的罚款。这些机构全都被指定为一级交易商，负责承销韩国国债，原因是它们在约三年半，即2020年1月至2023年6月期间限制市场竞争。

FTC表示，这15家机构在参加韩国国债竞争性拍卖之前，曾就投标利率和数量达成一致或交换敏感投标信息。FTC将此类行为认定为《垄断规制与公平交易法》规定的两类串谋：交换信息型串谋和围标。

KIS称，监管机构对约54万亿韩元销售额中其认定受串谋影响的部分适用4.5%的费率来计算罚款，随后再根据各公司的个别因素调整罚款金额。除经济处罚外，监管机构还决定将7家参与时间更长、串谋投标次数更多的机构移送检察机关开展刑事调查。

15家机构所受 individual penalties差异悬殊，罚款从39亿韩元至3322亿韩元不等，证券业承担了其中最大部分。10家证券公司被处以罚款总额的绝大部分，其中KB Securities以3322亿韩元创下单一机构最高罚款纪录。其后依次为NH Investment & Securities的2428亿韩元、Mirae Asset Securities的2148亿韩元、Shinhan Securities的1473亿韩元、Daishin Securities的1201亿韩元、Samsung Securities的1189亿韩元、Kiwoom Securities的838亿韩元、Meritz Securities的646亿韩元、Korea Investment & Securities的379亿韩元以及Kyobo Securities的137亿韩元。

行业风险：有限。对信用分析师而言，当前的关键变量包括各机构将多少罚款计入账簿、何时入账，上诉能否成功降低罚款金额，现金何时实际流出，以及下半年资本比率如何变化。KIS还指出，声誉和内部控制风险可能间接削弱这些机构的业务基础和信誉。

重点机构情况：KB Securities承受的负担最重。其3322亿韩元罚款相当于其权益的4.2%和2025年净利润的54.2%，并已被移送检察机关。该公司已在初步第三季度业绩中全额计提这项罚款。NH Investment & Securities的2428亿韩元罚款相当于其权益的2.5%和去年净利润的26.7%，并被移送检察机关。Mirae Asset Securities的2148亿韩元罚款相当于其权益的2.0%和2025年利润的36.1%，同样被移送检察机关。Shinhan Securities的1473亿韩元罚款相当于其权益的2.5%，但相当于其2025年净利润的41%，在15家机构中占比第三高。Daishin Securities的1201亿韩元罚款相当于其权益的2.6%，这一比例仅次于KB Securities排名第二，并相当于其2025年利润的25.3%。

Industrial Bank of Korea所受罚款在银行中最高，为1358亿韩元。这只相当于其权益的0.4%和2025年利润的5.7%。该行与Korea Development Bank均被移送检察机关。

罚款入账时间给企业资产负债表带来即时考验。KIS指出，尽管各机构记录费用的确切时间取决于其内部会计判断，但在FTC裁决已经明确具体金额的情况下，大多数公司预计将在第三或第四季度确认相关拨备。KB Securities已经在第三季度初步盈利披露中全额计提其3322亿韩元罚款。评级机构表示：“因此，以面临高额罚款的金融机构为主，2026年盈利能力可能大幅下降。”

罚款时点加剧了现有经营逆风。KIS指出，证券公司的整体经营环境在下半年正变得不利，这意味着巨额拨备将对年度净利润造成显著下行压力。尽管盈利受到严重挤压，KIS仍明确区分了盈利能力与资本稳健性。由于罚款占各公司权益的比例介于0.0%至4.2%之间，该机构认为，其对资本充足率的直接影响总体有限。

担任一级交易商的大型证券公司保持着相对雄厚的资本基础和稳固的业务基础。此外，2026年上半年的强劲经营表现为这些公司留下了充足的盈利缓冲，使其能够吸收监管费用，而不会令资本充足率失去稳定性。相对于自身规模，银行业面临的冲击更轻。除IBK的罚款相当于其权益的0.4%和2025年净利润的5.7%外，所有受罚银行所受罚款均未超过其权益的0.1%或去年净利润的3.6%。

一级交易商：由政府许可承销和交易国债的金融机构，有义务参与拍卖，并为政府债务做市。目前共有20家一级交易商，案件所覆盖期间为18家。它们必须在国债拍卖中投标，并为政府债务做市，因此是政府融资机制的核心环节。

围标：投标人就拍卖中将提交的价格（此处为利率）或数量达成协议，从而限制竞争。

交换信息型串谋：以限制竞争的方式与竞争对手分享具有竞争敏感性的信息，例如拟采用的投标利率，即使没有明确的价格协议也属于此类。

受影响销售额：监管机构认定受到违法行为影响的收入，用作计算罚款的基数。

拨备：公司针对未来可能发生且金额能够可靠估计的付款所计入的费用，计入时相应减少利润。

资本充足率：金融机构持有的资本相对于其风险的比例，用于衡量其吸收损失的能力。

暂缓执行：法院在诉讼尚未终结期间中止执行行政措施的命令，例如罚款缴纳。

受罚金融机构预计将审查FTC的书面裁决，并可能正式提出异议或提起行政诉讼，以推翻罚款。KIS预计，其抗辩策略将审查各机构在具体拍卖中的参与情况、违法持续时间、受影响销售额的计算以及罚款计算方法是否适当，尤其会区分存在具体利率和数量协议的拍卖与仅涉及信息交换的拍卖。

不过，提起诉讼并不会自动中止缴纳罚款的法定义务。KIS指出，企业可以在上诉期间申请暂缓执行、延长付款期限或分期付款。如果未获准暂缓执行，企业可能在诉讼仍在进行期间被迫支付罚款，从而立即产生现金流出。暂缓执行或分期安排虽能延后或分散流动性压力，但一旦满足确认拨备的会计标准，企业仍将立即承受损益冲击。

KIS表示，未来将密切监测各机构实际计提拨备的规模和时间、法律上诉进展、最终罚款的任何调整、支付罚款造成的资金负担，以及下半年盈利和资本比率。

FTC对15家一级交易商处以创纪录的1.63万亿韩元罚款，原因是它们在2020年至2023年间操纵国债拍卖。KIS预计，罚款将大幅削减受冲击最严重企业的2026年利润，其中KB Securities、NH Investment & Securities和Mirae Asset Securities首当其冲。由于罚款占任何一家公司权益的比例均不超过4.2%，该机构认为对资本充足率的直接损害有限。企业很可能会提出上诉，但除非法院中止付款，否则现金流出可能率先发生。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title: [MORNING CALM TALES] Déjà vu and the 'Yakult ajumma'
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary: She always looked the same — a light beige winter jacket, a matching cap, her breath hanging in the cold morning air as she pushed a small cart from one apartment building to the next. Korea Yakult Dairy was established in 1969 and entered into a joint venture agreement with Japan's Yakult company the following year. So by the time I wandered into Jamsil in the winter of 1991, there was nothing unusual about seeing a Yakult ajumma making her rounds.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary_zh: 她看起来始终如一——一件浅米色冬装外套、一顶同色帽子；清晨寒冷的空气中，她呼出的白气清晰可见，推着一辆小手推车从一栋公寓楼走向另一栋。韩国养乐多乳业成立于1969年，并于次年与日本养乐多公司签订合资协议。因此，1991年冬天我走进蚕室时，看到一位养乐多阿朱玛挨家挨户推销，并不 unusual。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body: The other day, I was walking back to my apartment when a familiar sight caught my eye. A woman was quietly gliding down the sidewalk in a small electric cart. As she came closer, my mind drifted back to the winter of 1991, when I was a young foreigner discovering Korea one small surprise at a time. During my first few weeks in Seoul, I became convinced I kept seeing the same woman. I saw her near my apartment in Jamsil. A day or two later, I spotted her several blocks away. Then there she was again outside the subway station. She always looked the same — a light beige winter jacket, a matching cap, her breath hanging in the cold morning air as she pushed a small cart from one apartment building to the next. Was I seeing the same woman? Was it déjà vu? Everywhere I went, there she was. Or so I thought. Back then, almost everything about Korea still seemed new to me. I could read Hangeul by then, even if I didn't always understand what I was reading, and I wandered through the city without much of a plan because I never knew what I might discover around the next corner. The sounds, the smells, the crowded markets, the tiny neighborhood shops, the buses, the street vendors, the rhythm of the city — it was all unlike anything I had known before. That was part of the adventure. But among all those unfamiliar things, certain sights slowly began to feel familiar. The Yakult "ajummas" were one of them. Eventually, of course, I realized I wasn't seeing the same woman at all. There were Yakult ajummas everywhere. By the time I arrived in Korea, they had already been part of everyday life for nearly 20 years. Yakult itself has an interesting history. The small, sweet fermented milk drink had been developed in Japan in the 1930s. The name traveled with the drink to Korea. Korea Yakult Dairy was established in 1969 and entered into a joint venture agreement with Japan's Yakult company the following year. In August 1971, Yakult went on sale in Korea. But just as distinctive as the little bottle was the way it was sold. That same year, women began carrying Yakult directly into Korean neighborhoods, selling it door to door from their carts. They became known simply as the "Yakult ajummas." It caught on quickly. By 1977, daily sales of Yakult in Korea had passed 1 million bottles. So by the time I wandered into Jamsil in the winter of 1991, there was nothing unusual about seeing a Yakult ajumma making her rounds. To most Koreans, she hardly warranted a second glance. To me, she was fascinating. One cold morning, curiosity finally got the better of me, and I stopped. She smiled, lifted the lid and revealed neat rows of tiny plastic bottles. I bought one. The bottle was so small I couldn't help but laugh. I had traveled halfway around the world only to discover that Koreans had somehow managed to put yogurt into a bottle about the size of my thumb. I stared at the empty bottle, then I looked back at the ajumma. After that, I found myself looking for the Yakult ajummas wherever I went. They pushed their little carts through apartment complexes and narrow neighborhood streets, stopping to chat with customers who greeted them like old friends. Office workers stepped outside when they approached. Elderly residents paused to exchange a few words before buying a bottle or two. They weren't simply selling yogurt. They were part of the neighborhood. Before long, I learned one of the most useful Korean phrases I knew at the time: “Yakult juseyo.” Yakult, please. In a country where almost everything still felt unfamiliar, they became one of the first familiar sights I could count on. I didn't realize it then, but those small encounters were part of the gradual process by which Korea began to feel less foreign, a little more familiar, a little more like home. More than 35 years have passed since those winter mornings in Jamsil. And that's when I found myself standing on that warm summer sidewalk, with the woman waiting patiently beside her electric cart, and for a moment the years simply disappeared. The carts have changed. The uniforms have changed. Even the name has changed. Today, they're officially known as "Fresh Managers." They ride electric carts and carry a much wider selection of yogurt and probiotic drinks than they did back then. But whenever I see one gliding quietly through a Korean neighborhood, I don't think of the modern cart or everything it carries. I remember those sweet Yakult ajummas from the winter of 1991. Jeffrey Miller is the author of several novels . His latest is " The Tree at Panmunjom ," about the 1976 Axe Murder Incident. Reach him at daejeonscribe@yahoo.com
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title_zh: 【晨间平静故事】似曾相识与“Yakult阿妈”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body_zh:
前些天，我正走回公寓，一个熟悉的场景吸引了我的目光。一名女子 quietly 地开着一辆小型电动车，沿着人行道平稳驶来。她越走越近，我的思绪飘回了1991年的冬天。那时，我是一名年轻的外国人，正一点一点地探索韩国，途中不断 Discovering 一个又一个惊喜。

在首尔的头几周，我渐渐确信自己总是看到同一个女人。我在蚕室附近见过她。一两天后，我又在几个街区外发现了她。接着，她出现在地铁站外。她看起来始终一模一样——一件浅米色冬装外套、一顶同色帽子；在一个个公寓楼之间推着小车前行时，她呼出的气息悬挂在寒冷清晨的空气中。我看到的是同一个女人吗？这是既视感吗？我走到哪里，她似乎都在那里。至少当时我是这么想的。

那时，对我而言，几乎所有有关韩国的事物都还显得新奇。那时我已经能够阅读韩文，尽管不总能理解自己读到的内容。我没有多少计划地穿行于城市，因为永远不知道下一个街角会发现什么。声音、气味、拥挤的集市、街角的小店、公交车、街头摊贩，以及城市的节奏——一切都与我此前所知截然不同。这正是冒险的一部分。

但在这些陌生事物之中，有些景象渐渐开始让我感到熟悉。Yakult“ajummas”就是其中之一。最终，我当然意识到自己看到的根本不是同一个女人。到处都是Yakult ajummas。我抵达韩国时，她们已经融入日常生活近20年了。

Yakult本身有一段颇有意思的历史。这种小巧、甜美的发酵乳饮料于20世纪30年代在日本开发出来。随着饮料一同传到韩国的，还有它的名称。Korea Yakult Dairy于1969年成立，并于次年与日本的Yakult公司签订合资协议。1971年8月，Yakult在韩国正式上市。

不过，与小瓶子本身同样鲜明的，还有它的售卖方式。就在那一年，妇女们开始用小车把Yakult直接带进韩国各个社区，逐户上门销售。她们从此被统称为“Yakult ajummas”。这种销售方式迅速流行起来。到1977年，Yakult在韩国的日销量已突破100万瓶。

因此，1991年冬天，我走进蚕室时，看到一位Yakult ajumma挨家挨户推销，并没有丝毫异常。对大多数韩国人而言，她几乎不值得多看一眼。可在我看来，她却充满魅力。

一个寒冷的早晨，好奇心终于占了上风，我停了下来。她微笑着掀开盖子，里面整齐排列着一排排小塑料瓶。我买了一瓶。瓶子小得让我忍不住发笑。我跨越半个地球来到韩国，最终发现的却是：韩国人不知怎么把酸奶装进了一个只有我的拇指大小的瓶子里。我盯着空瓶，然后又看向那位ajumma。

从那以后，无论走到哪里，我都会留意寻找Yakult ajummas。她们推着小车穿过住宅区和狭窄的社区街道，在途中停下来与熟客聊上几句，而顾客也像迎接老朋友一样迎接她们。办公室职员看到她们走近，便会走到外面。老年住户会停下脚步交谈几句，再买上一两瓶。

她们售卖的不只是酸奶。她们就是社区的一部分。没过多久，我学会了当时自己所知最有用的几句韩语之一：“Yakult juseyo.”——请给我一杯Yakult。

在一个几乎一切都仍显陌生的国家，她们成了我最早能够信赖的熟悉景象之一。当时我没有意识到，那些短暂的相遇正是韩国逐渐变得不再陌生、愈发熟悉、也愈发像家的一部分。

距蚕室那些冬日清晨，已经过去35年多。如今，我就站在温暖的人行道上，那名女子耐心地守在电动车旁。刹那间，岁月仿佛彻底消失了。

小车变了。制服变了。就连名称也变了。今天，她们正式被称为“Fresh Managers”。她们骑着电动车，携带的酸奶和益生菌饮料也比当年丰富得多。但每当看到其中一人静静穿过韩国社区，我想到的并不是现代小车，也不是车上陈列的种种商品。我记得的是1991年冬天那些甜美的Yakult ajummas。

Jeffrey Miller创作过多部小说。他的最新作品《The Tree at Panmunjom》讲述1976年_AX Murder Incident_。可通过daejeonscribe@yahoo.com与他联系。

MANILA, Philippines – The Philippines and Canada have concluded negotiations for a free trade agreement (FTA), the two countries announced on Saturday, November 14, ahead of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Summit in Manila. “The Philippines and Canada are pleased to announce the conclusion of negotiations of the Philippines-Canada FTA through a joint statement signed by the secretary of trade and industry of the Philippines and the minister of the international trade of Canada,” said Philippine Trade Secretary Cristina Aldeguer-Roque. Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney witnessed the signing of the joint statement alongside Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Saturday. Carney is also joining the summit as a guest of ASEAN chair Marcos. Roque said the two countries will work towards the signing of the FTA in 2027. “The joint statement also represents both countries’ commitment to expeditiously facilitate the implementation of the agreement and ensure that the resulting opportunities and benefits will directly impact the Filipino and Canadian peoples,” she said. Official talks for the FTA between Canada and the Philippines started only in October 2025 or just shortly before a different bilateral agreement on military ties was signed. The pace and level of bilateral engagement between Canada and the Philippines has grown dramatically under Marcos. In July 2026, the two countries agreed to elevate ties to a strategic partnership , a status that reflects increased ties in both security through their Status of the Visiting Forces Agreement and economically through the FTA. Both Carney and Marcos have argued for the importance of middle powers to come together amid shifts in the global order and threats to both global and regional security. Carney’s speech in Davos in January 2026 was spurred by United States President Donald Trump’s unilateral tariffs across the world, including on traditional partners like Canada and the Philippines. Bilateral ties between Canada and the US have continued to sour over Trump’s trade policies. For the Philippines, the threat is from its superpower neighbor China , which claims most of the South China Sea including the Philippines’ exclusive economic zone in the West Philippine Sea. Marcos made that pitch during the May 2024 Shangri-La Dialogue in Singapore. – Rappler.com Loading Related Topics ASEAN 2026 Canada Ferdinand Marcos Jr. Philippine trade trade agreements author Bea Cupin @beacupin Bea is a senior multimedia reporter who covers national politics. https://leadership.ng/zamfara-governor-a.body: The appointments which took immediate effect were announced on Friday by the Secretary to the State Government, Malam Abubakar Mohammad Nakwada in a statement signed by Suleman Ahmad Tudu, the senior special assistant (media) in the office of the Secretary to the State Government. The SSG said the appointments underscored Governor Lawal’s commitment to inclusive and participatory governance, strengthening grassroots engagement, broadening citizens’ involvement in government affairs and enhancing effective communication of government policies, programmes and achievements across the state. He said the action further reinforced the administration’s commitment to accountability, transparency and people-centred development under the Rescue and Rebuild Agenda. The appointees according to him will assist the governor in a wide range of roles, including community engagement, grassroots mobilisation, matters relating to persons with disabilities, media & publicity and other duties as may be assigned. The government said the new aides are expected to serve as effective bridges between government and the people, ensuring that diverse community voices are heard and reflected in governance. Lawal charged the appointees to demonstrate dedication, loyalty, professionalism and commitment to public service. He urged them to see their appointments not as political reward, but as a call to serve, and to work to ensure that government policies reach every ward and community in the state. https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body: The midterm elections in the United States that delivered a setback for President Donald Trump and led to a victory of the Democrats in the US Congress would not change India’s relationship with the country, External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar said on Saturday. Speaking with R Sukumar, Editor-in-Chief, Hindustan Times, at the 24th Hindustan Times Leadership Summit in New Delhi, Jaishankar said that there is consensus between India and the US on defence and security cooperation and other matters that are “not partisan" in the United States. “In some cases, we will be focusing on the administration, for example, trade negotiations because it is their jurisdiction. To some extent, it would matter. To some extent, we would be continuing what we are doing,” he said. In the recently held midterm elections, the Democrats seized both the House of Representatives and the Senate from the Republicans. In the House of Representatives, the Democrats won 256 seats, while the Republicans won 169 seats, Associated Press reported. Meanwhile, the Democrats won 55 seats in the US Senate, leaving Republicans with 44 seats. The turbulence the world is going through could last a few years, maybe till the end of the decade, he said, adding that India's compass for navigating these choppy waters is the "lens of national interest". He touched upon the conflicts in West Asia and Ukraine, and also spoke of the crises parts of Africa are facing. Jaishankar spoke of a readjustment of the world order that includes the rise of new powers. The rivalry between the United States and China, he said, was one of the factors behind the ongoing frictions, but not the only one

Yogendra Kumar, a traffic inspector posted in outer north Delhi, said pollution-related health risks for traffic personnel persists throughout the year but increases significantly when air quality deteriorates. “The impact on health is inevitable in the outskirts, as road dust also contributes to pollution alongside emissions. We have no safeguards apart from masks. Prolonged exposure causes breathing problems and a persistent cough,” he said. Reena Chaudhary, a domestic worker in Palam Colony, said she began experiencing breathing difficulties on the night before Deepavali, with her symptoms worsening on the festival day. “I leave home around 7 a.m. and return by 9 p.m. I began having headaches and burning eyes the day before Deepavali, particularly while passing through smoke-filled lanes between houses at night. On Deepavali, my condition worsened. I felt dizzy throughout the day, had a persistent cough and just wanted to lie down. But who would work if I did?” she said. Ms. Chaudhary said she had to walk through smoke on Deepavali night with her d upatta wrapped around her face. Since then, she has been taking her daughter along in case she falls ill and is unable to work. Ravi, a 21-year-old gig worker who attends college during the day, said he works through the night, picking up rides across the city to support his family. “Even at night, I can see that the air is dense and heavy. At times, I have to stop near a green area, such as Vande Mataram Marg, just to be able to breathe,” he said. Mukesh Yadav, an e-rickshaw driver in Palam, said road dust remains a problem throughout the year, apart from smoke from firecrackers and vehicular emissions. “The area remains dusty even on normal days. Since Deepavali, I have been tying a towel around my face,” he said. Mr. Yadav works eight to 10 hours a day, making several trips between Palam metro station and Kailashpuri, a one-kilometre stretch that witnesses heavy traffic. “The only time I am not outdoors is when I am charging my e-rickshaw. I thought my cough was due to the cold, but everyone seems to be coughing, even the passengers. It could be due to pollution,” he said. An analysis by the Centre for Science and Environment (CSE) found that Delhi’s average PM2.5 concentration in the week preceding Deepavali reached 236 micrograms per cubic metre, the highest in three years. This was 97% higher than the 120 micrograms per cubic metre recorded in 2025 and 32% above the 179 micrograms per cubic metre recorded in 2024. The study also found that time-bound restrictions on vehicles had failed to ease traffic congestion, with nitrogen dioxide, a marker of vehicular pollution, accumulating during the evening and remaining elevated until midnight, even after traffic had eased. “Deepavali pollution is an annual tipping point, but elevated particulate levels before the festival this year show that baseline pollution is higher than in previous years,” said Anumita Roychowdhury, executive director (research and advocacy) at the CSE. She said cleaner air ahead of winter and measures to contain episodic pollution spikes from farm fires and firecrackers could have prevented such severe pollution during seasonal weather changes. Track LIVE updates from Hindustan Times Leadership Summit here “It is certainly our hope and, I would say, in many ways, our expectation that we are in the final stretch. That is no secret. If Mr Piyush Goyal were sitting here, he would be able to give you a more detailed answer. But my understanding, since we consult very closely on this matter, is that we have sorted out the bulk of the issues. There are a few remaining issues to be addressed,” Jaishankar said. He added that, “In many cases, these concerns are not so much on our side, because the changes have been more on the American side than ours. So, the hope is that we should be able to conclude the deal soon.” Talking about what he described as impatience towards the final stage of any big event, Jaishankar said, “But look, in the final stages of any negotiation, everybody becomes impatient. People want to know what the specific issues are and how long it will take. Negotiators don't usually disclose such details during a negotiation." "Many years ago, I was involved in a nuclear negotiation, and we went through a very similar experience. People would ask: How long will it take? When will you conclude it? What is holding it up?” he said. The foreign minister also touched upon the conflicts in West Asia and Ukraine, and also spoke of the crises parts of Africa are facing. Jaishankar spoke of a readjustment of the world order that includes the rise of new powers. The rivalry between the United States and China, he said, was one of the factors behind the ongoing frictions, but not the only one. A strong and steady leadership is imperative in these times, he said

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/enug.body: Layer 1 …Group alleges 22-year concealment of registered constitution ..Dispute over rotational principle, five-year tenure of Ikenge A leadership crisis has erupted in Eziowa, Aguobu Owa Autonomous Community, Ezeagu Central Local Government Area of Enugu State, over the interpretation of the community’s constitution and the emergence of a new President-General of its Town Union. The crisis centres on allegations by a group, Concerned People of Eziowa, that a part of the community’s constitution, registered on February 8, 2004, was kept away from the people for about 22 years, resulting in disagreements over leadership succession and the tenure of traditional and town union office holders. The group, in a statement signed by Ozo Dr Ejike Orji on its behalf, alleged that a Certified True Copy (CTC) of the constitution initially made available to the community did not contain Page 23, which it said contains provisions governing the tenure and selection of members of the Igwe’s Cabinet and the office of Ikenge. It said a subsequent search at the Enugu State Ministry of Local Government and Chieftaincy Affairs enabled it to obtain another certified copy containing the disputed page. According to the group, the provisions of Page 23 stipulate a five-year review of the tenure of members of the Igwe’s Cabinet and provide for rotational occupation of the office of Ikenge among the community’s three villages, excluding the village that produces the reigning traditional ruler. It alleged that the office of Ikenge had remained with one individual beyond the stipulated period, arguing that the position was due for rotation between Ezema and Umudim villages. The group also cited Article Seven (1) of Page 12 of the constitution, which it said provides for a four-year tenure for the President-General and other Town Union executive members. It maintained that, following the expiration of the tenure of the previous executive in 2024, the process of electing a successor commenced in line with the constitutional provisions. According to the statement, Ezema Village, which it claimed was next in line to produce the President-General, constituted an electoral committee that conducted elections into the positions allocated to the village and announced the winners. However, the group alleged that disagreement arose after some stakeholders accepted the outcome of the village electoral committee in respect of other positions but rejected its choice of candidate for the office of President-General. It claimed that some stakeholders were insisting on a different candidate and had approached the state ministry over recognition of their preferred choice. The group, however, maintained that its preferred candidate emerged through the process prescribed by the community’s constitution. It further claimed that the newly elected President-General had been inaugurated, alongside other members of the Town Union executive, and that the new leadership had been presented to the state government in accordance with the constitutional provisions. The statement said the new executives had also been taken to the Town Union office at Umudim Road, Ugwu Afor, Aguobu Owa. Meanwhile, the group disclosed that the dispute had been referred to the police for investigation through the Commissioner of Police, Enugu State, at the Assistant Commissioner of Police, Oji River Area Command. It appealed to residents of the community to remain calm and law-abiding while the matter was being investigated. The group said its position was anchored on respect for the community’s constitution and called for adherence to its provisions in resolving the leadership disagreement. When contacted for a response, the Secretary to Igwe and Cabinet, Professor Hyacinth Chiegwu, told Vanguard that he had no hand in the allegations, adding that the said village to produce the the President General is the problem of itself. The Secretary to the Igwe and Cabinet, Professor Hyacinth Chiegwu, has distanced himself from the leadership crisis rocking Eziowa community, insisting that the controversy surrounding the emergence of its President-General is an internal village affair. Chiegwu, who spoke with Vanguard when contacted for his reaction, said he had neither participated in nor had detailed knowledge of the alleged irregularities surrounding the said missing article in the community’s constitution , and installation of the President-General. Although he confirmed that he was the Secretary to the Igwe and Cabinet, he said he had not been actively involved in the affairs of the body for a long time and had already handed over all relevant documents to the necessary parties. “My brother, I’m happy you called. Yes, I’m the Secretary, but to be sincere, I have not been going there for a long time. I gave them all the documents,” he said. On the demand for the community’s constitution and allegations that a particular article had been removed or torn out, Chiegwu said he was unaware of the circumstances surrounding its drafting, custody or alleged mutilation. “I didn’t know when the constitution was written. Since I became Secretary, we have never used it. I have never even seen the constitution. It was written before I joined, and there has never been any occasion that required its use for me to see it,” he said. He further insisted that he had not obstructed anybody in the process of installing the President-General, stressing that the disagreement was peculiar to the village concerned. “Whatever is happening about the installation of the PG is the problem of that particular village, not anybody else. To the best of my knowledge, I have never disturbed anybody,” he maintained. The secretary also expressed surprise at being drawn into the controversy, saying he had repeatedly told the person demanding documents from him that he had no knowledge of the issues being raised. “I told him not to involve me in what I do not know. I don’t know anything about those things, but he keeps calling me,” he added. Chiegwu said he had heard that a candidate from the village had already been installed and sworn in as President-General, although he was not present at the ceremony. “I even learnt that the person from that village has already been installed and sworn in, even though I wasn’t there. Is anybody preventing him from functioning as PG? If so, he should let me know, because all these are things I only heard about. I don’t know what is happening,” he said. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/enug.body_zh: 第一层……该组织指控已登记宪法被隐瞒22年……恩古州埃泽阿古中央地方政府辖区阿古博奥瓦自治社区埃齐奥瓦镇发生了围绕轮换原则、五年任期及伊肯格领导层危机的争端，争端源于对该社区宪法的解释以及镇联盟新任总会长的产生。危机焦点是“关心埃齐奥瓦人士”组织提出的一项指控：该社区于2004年2月8日登记的部分宪法被向民众隐瞒约22年，导致领导权继任以及传统官员和镇联盟公职人员任期问题出现分歧。该组织在一份由奥佐·埃杰克·奥吉代表其签署的声明中称，最初提供给社区的宪法经核证真实副本（CTC）没有第23页，而该组织表示，这一页载有管理伊格威内阁成员及伊肯格职位任期和遴选的条款。该组织称，随后在恩古州地方政府与酋长事务部查找时，他们得以取得另一份载有争议页面的核证副本。该组织表示，第23页的规定要求对伊格威内阁成员的任期每五年进行一次审查，并规定伊肯格职位由社区三个村庄轮流担任，但不包括现任传统统治者所属的村庄。该组织指控，伊肯格职位在规定期限届满后仍由同一人担任，并认为该职位理应在埃泽马村与乌穆迪姆村之间轮换。该组织还援引宪法第12页第七条（1），称该条规定总会长及镇联盟其他执行成员的任期为四年。该组织坚持称，上一届执行机构于2024年任期届满后，选举继任者的程序已依照宪法规定启动。声明称，据该组织所称，埃泽马村原应轮到其推选总会长，但该村成立了一个选举委员会，为分配给该村的职位举行选举并宣布获胜者。然而，该组织指控，在一些利益相关方接受该村选举委员会就其他职位作出的结果时，却拒绝接受其对总会长候选人的人选，其结果是有关方面坚持推举另一名候选人，并已向州政府主管部门寻求承认其所支持的人选。不过，该组织坚持认为，其支持的候选人是依照社区宪法规定的程序产生的。该组织进一步声称，新当选的总会长已与镇联盟其他执行成员一同就职，新领导层也已依照宪法规定向州政府呈报。声明称，新任执行人员还曾前往位于乌格武·阿福尔、阿古博奥瓦的乌穆迪姆路镇联盟办公室。与此同时，该组织透露，争议已由恩古州警察局长通过奥吉河地区警察指挥部助理警察局长提交警方调查。该组织呼吁社区居民在调查期间保持冷静并遵纪守法。该组织表示，其立场以尊重社区宪法为依据，并呼吁在解决领导层分歧时遵守宪法规定。记者联系伊格威内阁秘书 Hyacinth Chiegwu 教授回应此事时，他告诉《Vanguard》，自己并未参与有关指控，并补充称，上述应当推选总会长的村庄，其问题出在自身。《Vanguard》联系伊格威内阁秘书 Hyacinth Chiegwu 教授了解对此事的看法时，他表示，围绕该社区宪法中据称缺失条款及总会长就职问题所发生的争议，属于村庄内部事务。Chiegwu 表示，自己既未参与、也未详细了解有关社区宪法中据称缺失条款及总会长就职程序的不规范行为。尽管他确认自己担任伊格威内阁秘书，但他称自己长期以来并未积极参与该机构的事务，且已将所有相关文件移交给有关各方。他说：“兄弟，很高兴你打来电话。没错，我是秘书，但坦白说，我已经很久没有去那里了。我把所有文件都给了他们。”谈及要求提供社区宪法以及有人指控其中某一条款被删除或撕毁一事，Chiegwu 表示，他并不了解该宪法的起草、保管或据称遭破坏的相关情况。他说：“我不知道宪法是什么时候写成的。我担任秘书以来，我们从未使用过它。我甚至从未见过这部宪法。它是在我加入之前写成的，也从来没有出现过我因需要使用它而必须看到它的情况。”他进一步坚称，自己没有阻碍任何人完成总会长就职程序，并强调有关分歧是相关村庄自身的问题。他坚持说：“关于总会长的就职，无论发生什么，都是那个特定村庄的问题，不涉及任何人。据我所知，我从未干扰过任何人。”这位秘书还对被卷入此次争议表示惊讶，并称他曾反复告诉向他索要文件的有关人士，自己不了解所提出的问题。他说：“我告诉他，不要把我卷入我所不知道的事情。那些事情我一点也不清楚，但他还是不断给我打电话。”Chiegwu 表示，他听说该村的一名候选人已经就职并宣誓就任总会长，尽管他并未出席典礼。他说：“我甚至听说那个村的人已经就职并宣誓了，尽管我不在现场。有没有人妨碍他履行总会长职务？如果有，他应该告诉我，因为这些都只是我听说的事。我不知道正在发生什么。”本文所载评论不代表《Vanguard》报及其任何员工的意见

https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body: The turbulence the world is going through could last a few years, maybe till the end of the decade, External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar said on Saturday, adding that India's compass for steer through these choppy waters is the "lens of national interest". Jaishankar said the global order today was navigating "stormy seas" amid multiple conflicts, frictions and uncertainties, and was going through a transition. He was speaking to R Sukumar, Editor-in-Chief, Hindustan Times, at the 24th Hindustan Times Leadership Summit in New Delhi. The theme of this year's summit is "New Rules. New Realities." Track LIVE updates from Hindustan Times Leadership Summit here Asked what the "new world order" could look like, Jaishankar said it was not completely abstract, and stressed that it would be multipolar, with many decision-making centres. He said he hoped India would play a big role in it. "It [the world order] will have a transition and we are in the transition phase. We hope we have much stronger influence... an Indian perspective. The new order would be more multipolar...Many more centres of autonomous decision-making," he said. The foreign minister touched upon the conflicts in West Asia and Ukraine, and also spoke of the crises parts of Africa are facing. Speaking of the "readjustment" of the world order, which he said includes the rise of new powers, Jaishankar said the rivalry between the United States and China was one of the factors behind the ongoing frictions, but not the only one. "There are multiple causations here. But the US-China competition is a big part of the overall disturbance. One part of it is when countries get caught up in between," he said. A strong and steady leadership is imperative in these times, he said, adding that the turbulence was likely to "show up in different ways" over the next few years
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.title_zh: 苏杰生在全球 leaders summit 表示：面对动荡世界，“国家利益视角”是关键
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body_zh: 外交部长S·贾伊尚卡尔周六表示，世界正在经历的动荡可能持续数年，也许会延续到本十年末；印度驶过这些风浪的指南针是“国家利益视角”。贾伊尚卡尔说，当前的全球秩序在多重冲突、摩擦和不确定性中正穿行于“风暴之海”，并处于转型之中。他是在新德里举行的第24届《Hindustan Times》领导力峰会上接受《Hindustan Times》主编R·苏库马尔采访时作出上述表示的。本届峰会的主题是“新规则。新现实。”有关第24届《Hindustan Times》领导力峰会的最新进展，请在此关注。当被问及“新世界秩序”可能呈现何种面貌时，贾伊尚卡尔表示，这一概念并非完全抽象，并强调新秩序将是多极化的，拥有多个决策中心。他说，希望印度能在其中发挥重要作用。他说：“它［世界秩序］将经历转型，而我们正处于转型阶段。我们希望自己拥有更强的影响力……一种印度视角。新秩序将更加多极化……将有许多更多自主决策中心。”这位外交部长谈及西亚和乌克兰的冲突，也谈到非洲部分地区面临的危机。贾伊尚卡尔在谈到世界秩序的“重新调整”时表示，其中包括新势力的崛起；美国与中国的竞争是持续摩擦背后的因素之一，但并非唯一因素。他说：“这里存在多种成因。但美中竞争是整体动荡的重要组成部分。其中一个方面是，各国被夹在中间。”他说，在这样的时代，强而稳定的领导力至关重要，并补充称，未来数年，动荡很可能“以不同方式显现”……

https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Saturday paid tribute to former Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru on his 137th birth anniversary, as the nation observes Children's Day in his memory. Defence Minister Rajnath Singh also paid tribute to the country's first Prime Minister, recalling his contribution to India's freedom struggle and his leadership during the formative years of independent India. In a post on X, Singh said, "On the birth anniversary of Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru Ji, I pay my tributes to him. His contribution to India’s freedom struggle and his leadership as the first Prime Minister of independent India left an enduring imprint on the formative years of our nation." November 14 is observed as Children's Day across the country to mark the birth anniversary of Jawaharlal Nehru, who was popularly known as 'Chacha Nehru' for his affection towards children. After the death of Nehru, it was unanimously decided to celebrate his birthday as ' Bal Diwas ' or Children's Day in India. Nehru was born on November 14, 1889, in Uttar Pradesh's Prayagraj . He breathed his last on May 27, 1964. He became the prime minister on August 15, 1947, following an active role in the freedom struggle of the country. On this day, a number of activities are organised for students in schools nationwide, such as games, competitions, and so on, while government bodies pay tribute to the late prime minister and organise commemorative events on this day. In 1954, the United Nations declared November 20 as Universal Children's Day and India used to celebrate Children's Day on that day before 1956, but after the death of Prime Minister Nehru in 1964, a resolution was passed in the Parliament unanimously declaring the day of Nehru's birth anniversary as National Children's Day
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.title_zh: 莫迪总理在贾瓦哈拉尔·尼赫鲁诞辰137周年之际向其致祭
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body_zh: 印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪周六在贾瓦哈拉尔·尼赫鲁诞辰137周年之际，向这位前总理致敬；当全国按照尼赫鲁的纪念方式庆祝儿童节时，国防部长拉杰纳特·辛格也向印度首任总理致敬，回顾了他对印度独立运动的贡献，以及他在独立初期担任国家领导人的作用。辛格在X上发文称：“在潘迪特·贾瓦哈拉尔·尼赫鲁诞辰之际，我向他致以敬意。他对印度独立运动的贡献，以及他作为独立印度首任总理的领导，给我们国家形成时期留下了持久印记。”11月14日被全国作为儿童节庆祝，以纪念贾瓦哈拉尔·尼赫鲁的诞辰；他因对孩子的关爱而广受爱戴，被亲切称为“尼赫鲁叔叔”。尼赫鲁去世后，各方一致决定在印度把他的生日庆祝为“儿童节”。尼赫鲁于1889年11月14日出生于北方邦的普拉亚格拉杰。他于1964年5月27日逝世。由于积极参与国家独立运动，他于1947年8月15日就任总理。这一天，全国各地学校会为学生组织游戏、比赛等多种活动，政府机构也会向已故总理致敬，并组织纪念活动。1954年，联合国宣布11月20日为世界儿童日；在1956年以前，印度曾在这一天庆祝儿童节，但在总理尼赫鲁于1964年去世后，议会一致通过决议，将尼赫鲁的诞辰定为全国儿童节……
