https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.summary_zh: 前官员推出商会民谣专辑，改编经典十四行诗。前文化、体育和旅游副部长 Yong Ho-seong 正利用人工智能（AI）技术为古典文学谱曲，开启艺术生涯大胆崭新的篇章。他借助 AI 辅助作曲和演唱，为威廉·莎士比亚的15首十四行诗注入当代音乐生命力，共推出10张唱片。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body: Former official drops chamber folk album adapting classic sonnets Yong Ho-seong, former vice minister of culture, sports and tourism, is stepping into a bold new chapter of his creative life by using artificial intelligence (AI) technology to set classical literature to music. Performing under the stage name Dr. Dragon, Yong released his debut full-length album, "Fragile Beauty," on Nov. 10, breathing contemporary musical life into 15 of William Shakespeare's sonnets through AI-assisted composition and vocals. The release marks the first installment of "DiVerse," an ambitious ongoing project to set all 154 of Shakespeare's sonnets to modern music. The idea was sparked by a hardcover edition of Shakespeare's complete sonnets that a British friend gifted him during his tenure as director of the Korean Cultural Centre UK. "The name reflects both Shakespeare's original verse and the newly written lyrics, as well as the diverse musical genres used to reimagine centuries-old classics," Yong told The Korea Times during an interview in Seoul, Thursday. The former vice minister explained that the album's sound production leans into late-1960s avant-garde folk and chamber folk, driven by nylon-string guitars, upright contrabass, cellos, violas, flutes, harmoniums and bass clarinets, while featuring the contralto tones of his AI vocal persona NikkiD. "Rather than big, sweeping arrangements, the quiet, intimate sound of late-1960s chamber folk felt like the right fit for these poems," Yong said. Yong’s journey into music creation is rooted in a lifelong passion. Long before entering government service, he studied classical music and jazz extensively and built a massive personal collection of over 10,000 records. While serving as a government official, he also debuted as a music critic in 1993 after winning an annual music criticism competition hosted by the prominent performing arts magazine Auditorium. He has also spent decades playing drums in jazz and rock bands. After retiring from his career as a high-ranking bureaucrat last year — during which he played a pivotal role in establishing major cultural institutions and drafting key legislation — Yong turned his sights toward AI. In July, he won the AI.LOVE.JAZZ. composition competition in Montreux, Switzerland, with "Frozen Edge," a vocal jazz piece inspired by Shakespeare's Sonnet 97. For Yong, AI is not a replacement for human artistry, but an essential creative tool. "AI is a loyal assistant that expands the possibilities of songwriting and production," the creator said. "I write detailed prompts spanning a full page to specify rhythm, instrumentation and musical references, and sometimes regenerate a track 30 or 40 times before editing individual tracks myself until I find the exact sound I envision." Comparing AI to the historical introduction of digital sampling in popular music decades ago in the 1980s, the former official believes that technology ultimately broadens the base of music creators rather than diminishing human value. Rather than requiring years of formal composition training, individuals with a clear artistic perspective can now use these tools to bring their musical concepts to life, he added. "Just like sampling decades ago, AI acts as a faithful assistant that expands the pool of people who can create music, making the process far more efficient for everyone," Yong said. Looking ahead, he envisions how this collaborative approach could even transform traditional education by allowing students to turn personal stories and daily emotions into original songs. "When students learn to turn their daily experiences into melodies, music becomes a powerful tool for self-expression," Yong said. Following the release of "Fragile Beauty," Yong plans to issue a new sonnet-inspired album every month, spanning genres from jazz and blues to hip-hop, rap-metal and K-pop. He has already reached out to various Shakespeare-related societies, associations and academic institutions around the world to explore educational and cultural collaborations. He is also developing progressive rock operas based on Shakespeare's tragedies, such as "Hamlet" and "Macbeth," alongside a project reinterpreting the poetry of Joseon Dynasty poet Yi Mae-chang (1573-1610). "Just as I am reimagining Shakespeare, I wanted to bring the poignant and soul-searching poetry of Yi Mae-chang into contemporary folk and blues," Yong said. While the former vice minister devotes up to six hours a day to composing and two hours of practicing drums, Yong said his creative ventures are fueled by personal fulfillment rather than commercial success. He recently earned his first-ever revenue as a musician by composing a theme song for T&C Foundation, a public interest foundation, though the ex-official primarily views his creative output as a natural extension of a well-prepared second act in life. "For me, happiness is not about the high intensity of achievements, but the frequency of joyful moments," Yong said. "Whether it is practicing drums in the morning or giving classical literature a new voice through modern music, I am simply enjoying a life where I can freely explore what I love."
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.title_zh: 前副部长借助人工智能音乐让莎士比亚鲜活起来
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body_zh:
前官员发行室内民谣专辑，以人工智能改编古典十四行诗
前文化、体育和旅游部副部长龙浩成正以人工智能（AI）技术为古典文学谱曲，开启创意人生的大胆新篇章。他以艺名“Dragon博士”演出，11月10日发行首张完整专辑《脆弱之美》，通过人工智能辅助作曲和人声演绎，为威廉·莎士比亚的15首十四行诗注入当代音乐生命力。这次发行是“DiVerse”计划的第一部分；该雄心勃勃的持续项目旨在将莎士比亚全部154首十四行诗谱成现代音乐。这一构想源于一位英国朋友在他担任韩国文化中心英国主任期间送给他的《莎士比亚十四行诗全集》精装版。龙浩成周四在首尔接受《韩国时报》采访时表示：“这个名字既反映莎士比亚的原诗，也体现新创作的歌词，以及重新演绎百年经典时采用的多样音乐类型。”这位前副部长介绍，专辑的声音制作以20世纪60年代末的前卫民谣和室内民谣为主，由尼龙弦吉他、立式低音提琴、大提琴、中提琴、长笛、风琴和低音单簧管支撑，并展现其人工智能人声形象NikkiD的女中音音色。龙浩成说：“与宏大、层层铺陈的编曲相比，20世纪60年代末室内民谣安静而亲密的声音，更适合这些诗。”
龙浩成投身音乐创作，源于一生的热爱。早在进入政府部门之前，他就广泛学习古典音乐和爵士乐，并收藏了1万多张唱片。担任政府官员期间，他还在1993年赢得知名表演艺术杂志《Auditorium》主办的一年一度音乐评论比赛，首次以乐评人身份登台。他还花了数十年时间在爵士和摇滚乐队中担任鼓手。去年从高级官僚职位退休——任职期间，他在建立重要文化机构和起草关键立法方面发挥了关键作用——后，龙浩成将目光转向人工智能。今年7月，他凭借受莎士比亚第97首十四行诗启发创作的声乐爵士作品《冰冻边缘》，在瑞士蒙特勒赢得AI.LOVE.JAZZ.作曲比赛。这位创作者表示，对龙浩成而言，人工智能不是人类艺术创作的替代品，而是一种不可或缺的创作工具。他说：“人工智能是一名忠实的助手，扩大了歌曲创作和制作的可能性。我会写满整整一页的详细提示词，规定节奏、乐器配置和音乐参考，有时还会将一首曲子重新生成30或40次，再亲自编辑各个音轨，直到找到自己设想的确切声音。”
这位前官员将人工智能与20世纪80年代数字采样技术首次引入流行音乐作比较，认为技术最终拓宽了音乐创作者的群体，而非削弱人的价值。他补充说，人们不必再经过多年的正规作曲训练，只要拥有清晰的艺术视角，如今就能利用这些工具让音乐构想成为现实。龙浩成说：“就像几十年前的采样一样，人工智能是一名忠实的助手，扩大了能够创作音乐的人群，让每个人的创作过程都高效得多。”
展望未来，他设想这种协作方式甚至可以改变传统教育，让学生能够将个人故事和日常感受转化为原创歌曲。龙浩成说：“当学生学会把日常经历化为旋律时，音乐就成为自我表达的强大工具。”继《脆弱之美》发行后，龙浩成计划每月推出一张受十四行诗启发的专辑，涵盖爵士、布鲁斯、嘻哈、说唱金属和K-pop等多种风格。他还联系了世界各地与莎士比亚有关的社团、协会和学术机构，探讨教育与文化合作。他也在根据莎士比亚的悲剧创作前卫摇滚歌剧，如《哈姆雷特》和《麦克白》，同时推进一个重新诠释朝鲜王朝诗人李梅昌（1573—1610）诗歌的项目。龙浩成说：“就像我重新演绎莎士比亚一样，我也希望把李梅昌那些动人、直击灵魂的诗歌带入当代民谣和布鲁斯。”
这位前副部长每天最多投入六小时作曲，并花两小时练习鼓乐。龙浩成说，他的创作动力来自个人满足感，而非商业成功。他最近通过为公益基金会T&C Foundation创作主题曲，首次获得音乐人生的第一笔收入；但这位前官员主要把自己的创作成果视为充分准备的人生第二幕的自然延伸。龙浩成说：“对我来说，快乐不在于成就的高强度，而在于欢乐时刻的频率。无论是清晨练鼓，还是通过现代音乐为古典文学赋予新声，我只是在享受一种能够自由探索所爱之物的生活。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.title: Google complies with Korea's security requirements for high-precision map data: gov't
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.summary: The Korean government said Friday that Google has complied with security requirements imposed as a condition for allowing the transfer of high-precision map data overseas. The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport said a government-led consultation body reviewed Google's implementation of security measures following its conditional approval in February to export 1:5,000-scale digital map data.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.summary_zh: 韩国政府周五表示，Google已经遵守相关安全要求；这些要求是获准向海外传输高精度地图数据的附加条件。国土交通部表示，政府牵头的咨询机构审查了Google落实安全措施的情况。该机构曾于2月有条件批准Google出口比例尺为1:5000的数字地图数据。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body: The Korean government said Friday that Google has complied with security requirements imposed as a condition for allowing the transfer of high-precision map data overseas. The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport said a government-led consultation body reviewed Google's implementation of security measures following its conditional approval in February to export 1:5,000-scale digital map data. The review found that the global tech giant had implemented measures to prevent the exposure of geographic coordinates, as well as sensitive military and security facilities, on its global Google Maps and Google Earth services, including web and mobile platforms. To meet the requirements, Google developed a dedicated control system for Korea and introduced safeguards to block app updates if they risk exposing restricted geographic coordinates. In August, Google also signed an agreement to obtain satellite imagery processed for security purposes by the National Geographic Information Institute (NGII) through a local partner. Google is said to have chosen the local navigation company, TMAP Mobility, to process base map data, according to industry sources. Under the agreement, Google must replace existing imagery on its map services as soon as it receives the security-processed images, without making any modifications. Currently, Naver Map, operated by the local portal giant Naver Corp., is the most widely used service in the country, with monthly active users of 31.2 million in October, according to data from market tracker Mobile Index. TMAP came next with 15.1 monthly active users, followed by Kakao Map with 13.8 million users and Google Map with 10.5 million users locally
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.title_zh: 韩国政府：Google遵守韩国对高精度地图数据的安全要求
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body_zh: 韩国政府周五表示，Google 已遵守相关安全要求；这些要求是允许其向海外传输高精度地图数据的附加条件。国土交通部表示，政府牵头的咨询机构审查了 Google 在2月获准出口比例尺为1:5,000的数字地图数据后所采取安全措施的落实情况。审查发现，这家全球科技巨头已在旗下 Google Maps 和 Google Earth 服务（包括网页端和移动端）实施相关措施，防止泄露地理坐标以及敏感的军事和安全设施。为满足有关要求，Google 为韩国开发了一套专用控制系统，并设置安全防护机制，在应用更新可能暴露受限地理坐标时予以阻止。今年8月，Google 还签署了一项协议，将通过一家本地合作伙伴获取由国家地理信息院（NGII）出于安全目的处理的卫星图像。据行业消息人士称，Google 选择了本地导航企业 TMAP Mobility 处理基础地图数据。根据该协议，Google 在收到经过安全处理的图像后，必须立即替换其地图服务中的现有图像，且不得作任何修改。据市场追踪机构 Mobile Index 的数据，目前由本地门户网站巨头 Naver Corp. 运营的 Naver Map 是韩国使用最广泛的服务，10月月活跃用户达到3120万。TMAP 以1510万月活跃用户紧随其后，Kakao Map 和 Google Map 在当地的月活跃用户分别为1380万和1050万

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111317.summary_zh: （北京、首尔=韩联社）韩中首席特派记者金智宪报道：外交部长赵显13日就朝鲜半岛问题呼吁中国发挥建设性作用。中国外交部长王毅表示，中国对朝鲜半岛的政策没有改变，并将继续为朝鲜半岛的和平与稳定发挥建设性作用。外交部表示，两位外交部长当天下午在北京钓鱼台国宾馆举行会谈并共进晚餐，双方就韩中关系、朝鲜半岛问题等共同关心的事项交换了意见，会谈持续3小时。
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111317.body: (베이징·서울=연합뉴스) 한종구 특파원 김지헌 기자 = 조현 외교부 장관이 13일 한반도 문제와 관련한 중국의 건설적 역할을 당부했다. 왕이 중국 외교부장은 중국의 한반도 정책에는 변함이 없다면서 한반도 평화·안정을 위한 건설적 역할을 지속해 나갈 것임을 재확인했다. 외교부는 두 장관이 이날 오후 중국 베이징 댜오위타이(釣魚臺) 국빈관에서 3시간에 걸쳐 외교장관회담과 만찬을 갖고 한중 관계와 한반도 문제 등 상호 관심사에 대해 의견을 교환했다고 밝혔다. 조 장관은 한반도의 평화·안정이 한중 양국의 공동 이익임을 강조했고 한반도 비핵화와 평화 실현을 위한 정부의 노력을 설명했으며 북한의 대화 복귀 등 한반도 문제에서 중국의 역할을 당부했다. 왕 부장은 이에 대해 답하면서 '비핵화' 표현을 명시적으로 쓰지 않는 최근의 태도를 이어갔지만, 비핵화가 포함되는 기존의 중국 대한반도 정책에 변함이 없다는 입장을 반복했다. 왕 부장은 지난 8월 서울에서 조 장관과 외교장관회담을 벌였을 때도 '한반도 문제에 대한 중국의 입장은 연속적이고 안정적'이라는 취지로 언급한 바 있다. 회담에서 조 장관은 정부가 작년 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의 의장국으로서 내주 개최되는 선전 APEC 정상회의의 성공적 개최를 기원한다고 했다. 이어 선전에서 양국 정상 간 교류가 한중 전략적 협력 동반자 관계를 더욱 성숙하게 발전시키는 중요한 계기가 될 수 있도록 잘 준비해 나가자고 했다. 왕 부장은 한중 관계의 긍정적 흐름이 작년 경주에서 선전으로 이어지고 있음을 평가하면서 이재명 대통령의 선전 APEC 계기 방중을 환영하며 충분한 예우를 갖춰 이번 방문이 성공적으로 이루어질 수 있도록 하겠다고 화답했다. 양 장관은 작년과 올해 양국 정상의 상호 국빈방문을 통한 한중관계 전면 복원의 흐름이 구체 성과로 나타나고 있음을 평가하고, 내년 수교 35주년을 맞아 양국 국민이 체감할 수 있는 실질적인 성과를 지속 창출해 나가기 위한 여러 방안에 대해 논의했다. 특히 한중 자유무역협정(FTA) 서비스·투자 협상 진전을 통해 양국의 수평적·호혜적 경제협력의 기반을 강화해 나가는 한편 양 국민 간 인적교류를 확대하고 우호정서를 증진하기 위한 노력도 강화해 나가자는 데도 의견을 같이 했다. 조 장관은 서해 문제 등 사안에서 한국의 원칙적 입장을 전달했으며 중국 내 한국 국민의 안전과 권익 보호를 위한 중국 정부의 노력도 당부했다. 이와 관련해 양 장관은 이런 사안들이 양국 관계 발전에 걸림돌이 되지 않도록 세심하게 관리해 나가자는 데 공감했다고 외교부가 전했다. 회담의 본격적 시작에 앞서 조 장관은 모두발언을 통해 "한반도 문제는 대한민국의 사활적 이익이며 한반도 평화와 안정은 양국의 공동이익"이라며 "한반도 정세 진전을 위해 양국 간 전략적 소통을 계속 강화해 나가기를 기대한다"고 말했다. 이어 "다음 주 선전에서 양국 정상이 10개월 만에 다시 만나 한중 전략적 협력 동반자 관계를 더욱 성숙하게 발전시켜 나가는 중요한 계기를 만들 것으로 기대한다"며 "경주에서 시작된 두 정상 간 우정과 신뢰의 이야기가 베이징을 거쳐 선전으로 이어지면서 한중 관계도 더욱 돈독해지기를 희망한다"고 말했다. 조 장관은 지난해 11월과 올해 1월 양국 정상의 상호 국빈 방문 이후 한중 관계가 전면 복원의 흐름을 공고히 해왔다고 평가했다. 그러면서 "올해 한중 인적 교류는 1천만명을 돌파할 것으로 예상된다"며 "한중 간 교역도 40% 넘게 증가했다"고 말했다. 이어 "이는 양국 정상 간 전면적 관계 복원에 대한 공동 인식을 이행하기 위해 양국 정부가 긴밀히 소통하며 함께 노력해온 결과"라고 강조했다. 조 장관은 이번 회담을 통해 다음 주 양국 정상의 만남이 성공적으로 이뤄질 수 있도록 협의하기를 기대한다고 덧붙였다. 왕 부장은 모두발언에서 "지난해 말과 올해 초 시진핑 국가주석과 이재명 대통령의 성공적인 상호 방문으로 중한 관계가 개선과 발전의 정상 궤도로 돌아왔다"고 https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111317.title_zh: 赵兑烈呼吁中国在半岛问题上发挥建设性作用；王毅表示政策没有改变（综合）
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111317.body_zh: （北京、首尔＝韩联社）韩中阁特派记者金智宪报道＝外交部长赵显13日敦促中国在朝鲜半岛问题上发挥建设性作用。王毅表示，中国对朝鲜半岛的政策没有变化，并重申将持续为朝鲜半岛的和平与稳定发挥建设性作用。外交部表示，两国外长当日下午在北京钓鱼台国宾馆举行会谈并共进晚餐，历时3小时，就韩中关系、朝鲜半岛问题等双方共同关心的问题交换了意见。赵部长强调，朝鲜半岛的和平与稳定符合韩中两国的共同利益，并介绍了韩国政府为半岛无核化与和平实现所作的努力，同时敦促中国在朝鲜重返对话等半岛问题上发挥作用。王毅在回应时延续了近来未明确使用“无核化”表述的做法，但再次强调，中国既有的半岛无核化政策没有变化。王毅还表示，去年8月在首尔与赵部长举行外长会谈时曾提及，中国对半岛问题的立场具有连续性和稳定性。会谈中，赵部长表示，作为去年亚太经合组织（APEC）领导人会议主席国，韩国政府希望下周在宣城举行的APEC领导人会议取得圆满成功。他接着说，双方应做好充分准备，使两国领导人之间的交流成为推动韩中全面战略合作伙伴关系进一步成熟发展的重要契机。王毅评价，韩中关系的积极势头正从去年庆州延续至宣城，并表示欢迎李在明总统借APEC会议之机访问中国，将给予充分礼遇，确保此次访问取得成功。两位外长评价，通过去年和今年两国领导人相互进行国事访问所推动的韩中关系全面恢复趋势正在转化为具体成果，并就迎接明年建交35周年、持续为两国国民带来切实成果的多种方案进行了讨论。双方尤其同意，将通过推进韩中自由贸易协定（FTA）服务与投资谈判，进一步夯实两国平等、互利的经济合作基础，同时加强扩大两国国民之间的人员交流以及促进友好感情的努力。赵部长转达了韩国在黄海问题等议题上的原则立场，并敦促中国政府为保护在中国韩国国民的安全和权益而努力。外交部介绍，围绕这些议题，双方同意将审慎管控，避免其成为两国关系发展的障碍。会谈正式开始前，赵部长在全体发言中表示：“朝鲜半岛问题关系到韩国的切身利益，朝鲜半岛的和平与稳定符合两国共同利益。”“我们期待韩中两国继续加强战略沟通，为半岛局势取得进展作出贡献。”他接着说：“我们期待下周在宣城，两国领导人时隔10个月再次会晤，并以此为重要契机，推动韩中全面战略合作伙伴关系进一步成熟。”他还说：“希望从庆州开启的两位领导人之间的友谊与信任故事经由北京延续到宣城，同时期待韩中关系更加亲近。”赵部长评价，去年11月和今年1月两国领导人相互进行国事访问后，韩中关系全面恢复的趋势进一步巩固。他强调：“预计今年韩中人员交流将突破1000万人次，两国之间的贸易额也增长了40%以上。”“这是两国政府为落实两国领导人全面恢复关系的共同共识而紧密沟通、共同努力的结果。”赵部长补充说，希望通过此次会谈协商，推动下周两国领导人会晤取得成功。王毅在全体发言中评价：“去年底和今年初，习近平主席与李在明总统成功进行相互访问，推动中韩关系重回改善与发展的正确轨道。”他接着强调：“为筹备下一阶段的高层接触，必须做好充分准备。”“明年正值中韩建交35周年，两国应以此为契机共同努力，推动全面战略合作伙伴关系沿着正确轨道发展。”王毅预计，今年两国贸易额将创历史新高，人员往来也将恢复到每年1000万人左右的水平。他表示，包括李在明总统在内的多个成员国领导人已确定出席下周在宣城举行的APEC领导人会议，并评价韩国去年成功举办庆州APEC领导人会议。他表示：“既然韩中两国接连举办APEC会议，两国就应携手并进，共同推进建设亚太命运共同体，促进地区共同发展与繁荣。”王毅还高度评价韩国积极参与并助力中国筹备APEC会议，并期待宣城领导人会议为两国关系提供新动力。图片来源：KakaoTalk okjebo <版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、再发布及用于人工智能学习和应用> 2026/11/13 23:47发稿 2026年11月13日23时47分发稿（北京＝韩联社）韩中阁特派记者＝13日下午，在中国北京钓鱼台国宾馆举行韩中外长会谈，外交部长赵显、中国外交部长王毅等人出席。2026.11.13. https://www.myjoyonline.com/how-a-sex-sc.body: The Nvidia boss was one of the few business leaders with direct access to the US president. He had met Trump repeatedly, travelled with him to Britain and, in May, joined him on Air Force One for his trip to China. Jensen Huang wasn't just another tech billionaire seeking the president's ear. He had become an important voice in one of the biggest arguments inside the administration: how much of America's most advanced technology should be allowed to reach China. Nvidia makes the chips that power the AI revolution. Washington has restricted exports of its most advanced processors to China since 2022, believing they could help Beijing develop its military and technological capabilities. But enforcing those restrictions is difficult. Chips can be bought legally by customers in countries such as Singapore and Malaysia and then diverted to China. Chinese companies can also rent access to computing power through data centres outside the country. Jensen Huang has long argued that the restrictions are counterproductive. They shut Nvidia out of a huge market and encourage Chinese companies to develop their own alternatives. Trump appeared sympathetic to this view, allowing Nvidia to resume sales of certain chips to China last year in return for a share of the revenue, although its most advanced Blackwell chips remain off limits. The allegations surrounding Jensen Huang's reported affair with Alice Huang, of no relation but a former executive at Singapore-based company Megaspeed, have raised the possibility that a foreign intelligence operation was targeting not just a powerful businessman, but someone with unusually close access to the American president. US intelligence reportedly suspects Alice Huang of having links to Chinese intelligence. Beijing has rejected the allegations. Nvidia's board says it has no reason to believe company secrets or national security were compromised. But the affair has opened up a much bigger question: what did the administration in Washington know, and what did it do about it? His department was responsible for controlling exports of sensitive American technology. It was also being pressed to act on concerns about Megaspeed, an Nvidia customer suspected of helping divert advanced chips to China. On Thursday, Megaspeed chief executive, Tan Yong Pong, also known as James Tan, said the company "takes its compliance obligations under US export control laws extremely seriously" and is "committed to working constructively and transparently with the US government". He said the company had co-operated with US Commerce Department inspections. A highly classified memo was shared with Lutnick about the concerns surrounding Alice Huang and Megaspeed. He resisted taking action against the company, a decision that is now under scrutiny. Other senior officials wanted a tougher response. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent was among those who reportedly questioned why Megaspeed had not been placed on the Commerce Department's blacklist. There were also questions about why an investigation into the Singapore-based company was stopped after Nvidia intervened. The New York Times reported that Nvidia's general counsel contacted Commerce Department investigators probing suspected chip smuggling by Megaspeed, invoking a senior Trump appointee. The department allegedly then froze its investigation and handed the case to the Justice Department. This apparently highlighted a significant disagreement about the direction of Trump's China policy. Huang wanted access to the Chinese market. Other officials were supposedly worried about the national security consequences. Lutnick was caught in the middle. Members of Congress from both parties want answers. Democrats have launched an investigation into how the Commerce Department vetted Chinese companies approved to buy AI chips. Republicans are also questioning the administration's approach. Republican representative John Moolenaar, who chairs the House Select Committee on China, said it was in the national interest for Nvidia and other American AI firms to succeed, but that companies "should never jeopardise our nation's security" by giving Chinese firms access to their most advanced chips. Senator Elizabeth Warren, the top Democrat on the Senate Banking Committee, said Huang's resignation did not absolve him of responsibility, and urged Lutnick to explain why export control loopholes remain open. Meanwhile Jensen Huang's team told Republican lawmakers on Wednesday that he plans to cooperate with their request to testify behind closed doors. The White House has not responded to the BBC's request for comment. It has, however, told the New York Post that Trump has complete confidence in Lutnick, describing him as "the most transformative commerce secretary in modern history". That is a fairly emphatic show of support, particularly amid reports that officials are weighing whether Lutnick should be forced out. There are some obvious questions. If Lutnick had indeed been warned about the risks, why did his department fail to act? And if other senior officials were indeed pressing for action, why did it take so long? The BBC has contacted the Commerce Department for comment. But there is an even bigger question for Trump. The president cultivated a close relationship with Huang. He was directly involved in decisions about chip sales to China. And, according to reporting in the New York Times, he was briefed on the intelligence concerns. This is becoming difficult to dismiss as the misjudgement of one businessman or one government department. Jensen Huang's personal life may have triggered the crisis, but the questions now reach into the White House itself. How much influence did he have? What did the president know? And who was ultimately responsible for protecting America's most sensitive technology?

https://www.myjoyonline.com/how-a-sex-sc.body_zh: 英伟达老板黄仁勋是少数能够直接接触美国总统的企业领袖之一。他曾多次与特朗普会面，陪同他前往英国，并于5月搭乘美国空军一号随行访问中国。黄仁勋并非又一个试图向总统进言的科技富豪。他已成为本届政府内部最大争论之一中的重要声音：美国应允许多少最先进技术流入中国？英伟达制造驱动人工智能革命的芯片。自2022年以来，华盛顿一直限制英伟达向中国出口最先进的处理器，认为这些芯片可能帮助北京发展军事和技术能力。但执行这些限制并不容易。客户可以在新加坡、马来西亚等国家合法购买芯片，随后转售至中国。中国企业还可通过租用境外数据中心的算力来获取计算资源。黄仁勋长期认为，这些限制会适得其反。它们让英伟达被排除在一个庞大市场之外，并促使中国企业开发自己的替代产品。特朗普似乎认同这一观点，去年允许英伟达恢复向中国销售部分芯片，以换取部分收入分成，但其最先进的Blackwell芯片仍禁止出口。有关黄仁勋据报与Alice Huang有婚外情的指控掀起了更多疑问。Alice Huang与黄仁勋没有亲属关系，曾任职于总部位于新加坡的公司Megaspeed。这些指控表明，外国情报行动的针对目标可能不仅是一位权势显赫的商人，还是一位与关系异常密切的美国总统接触频繁的人。据报道，美国情报部门怀疑Alice Huang与中国情报机构有关联。北京否认了这些指控。英伟达董事会表示，没有理由相信公司机密或国家安全受到损害。但这段婚外情引出了一个更大的问题：华盛顿政府知道多少，又采取了什么措施？他的部门负责管制美国敏感技术出口。与此同时，该部门还面临压力，需要就Megaspeed引发的担忧采取行动。这家英伟达客户被怀疑协助将先进芯片转运至中国。周四，Megaspeed首席执行官Tan Yong Pong（又名James Tan）表示，公司“极其认真地履行美国出口管制法律规定的合规义务”，并“致力于与美国政府建设性、透明地合作”。他说，公司曾配合美国商务部检查。一份高度机密的备忘录被提交给Lutnick，内容涉及围绕Alice Huang和Megaspeed的担忧。他拒绝对该公司采取行动，而这一决定如今正受到审视。其他高级官员希望采取更强硬的回应。据报道，财政部长Scott Bessent也在质疑者之列，他问Megaspeed为何未被列入商务部黑名单。还有人追问，在英伟达介入后，为何针对这家新加坡公司的调查会被终止。《纽约时报》报道，英伟达总法律顾问联系了调查Megaspeed涉嫌走私芯片的商务部调查人员，并援引了一位由特朗普任命的高级官员。随后，据称该部门暂停调查，并将案件移交司法部。这似乎凸显了特朗普对华政策方向上的重大分歧。黄仁勋希望获得中国市场准入，而其他官员则担心可能产生的国家安全后果。Lutnick夹在中间。两党议员都要求得到答案。民主党人对商务部如何审查获准购买人工智能芯片的中国企业展开调查，共和党人也在质疑本届政府的做法。共和党众议员John Moolenaar担任众议院中国问题特别委员会主席。他说，让英伟达和其他美国人工智能企业取得成功符合国家利益，但企业“绝不应”因向中国企业提供其最先进芯片的使用权而危及国家安全。参议院银行委员会首席民主党参议员Elizabeth Warren表示，黄仁勋辞职并不能免除他的责任，并敦促Lutnick解释出口管制漏洞为何仍未堵住。与此同时，黄仁勋的团队周三告诉共和党议员，他计划配合他们的要求，闭门作证。白宫尚未回应BBC的置评请求。不过，白宫告诉《纽约邮报》，特朗普完全信任Lutnick，称他是“现代历史上最具变革性的商务部长”。这是相当有力的支持，尤其是在有报道称官员正在权衡是否应迫使Lutnick下台之际。这里有一些显而易见的问题。如果Lutnick确实曾获警告风险，他的部门为何没有采取行动？如果其他高级官员确实在敦促采取行动，为何要等那么久？BBC已联系商务部置评。但对特朗普而言，还有一个更大的问题。总统与黄仁勋建立了密切关系，并直接参与了有关向中国销售芯片的决策。据《纽约时报》报道，他曾听取有关情报方面担忧的简报。这越来越难以被解释为单个商人或单个政府部门的误判。黄仁勋的个人生活可能触发了这场危机，但如今相关问题已延伸至白宫本身。他对政府有多大影响力？总统知道什么？最终，谁负责保护美国最敏感的技术？

https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/i.body: Account subscription benefits alongside Premium Stories, Editorials, Opinions and more. Unlock these with Subscription In a significant breakthrough towards the conclusion of the India-U.S. interim deal on trade, the U.S. has assured India of a comparative advantage over its competitors once it finalises its tariff structure, a senior official in the Ministry of Commerce and Industry said, adding that both sides are working to complete the deal by the end of the current financial year. Indian officials have repeatedly been saying that India would move ahead with a deal only if the U.S. assured it of a comparative advantage, as was agreed to in the February 2026 joint statement between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and U.S. President Donald Trump. Separately, Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal confirmed that a two-man team from the U.S. visited India earlier this month during which substantial progress was made towards finalising the text of the deal. “Talks between India and the U.S. are ongoing and the U.S. has assured us of a comparative advantage over our competitor countries,” the senior official said on the condition of anonymity as the details of the bilateral discussions have not yet been made public. This is a significant development because Indian officials, including Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal, have repeatedly said that India would move ahead with a deal with the U.S. only if it is assured of a comparative advantage over its competitors. The February joint statement stated that the U.S. and India “commit to provide each other preferential market access in sectors of respective interest on a sustained basis”. However, since then, the U.S. has imposed additional 10% ‘forced labour’ tariffs on India, the same as on some of its competitors such as Indonesia, Malaysia, Pakistan, and Sri Lanka. Further, the U.S. is currently conducting another investigation into India and several other countries related to excess capacity, which could see additional tariffs being levied. The official, however, said that the U.S. assurance of comparative advantage for India takes into account this future tariff. “The attempt by both sides is to complete the deal by the end of this financial year,” the official added. “We have also agreed to a clause that says that if either country changes its tariffs on the other country, then the second country can also modify its commitments under the deal. This was also a part of the February joint statement.” The official said that such a clause is “not usual” in trade deals that India enters into, but that it had specifically been included in the deal with the U.S. Separately, Mr. Agrawal said that the talks between the two sides were “on the right track” and that the teams are engaged both in-person and virtually. “There was a small team from the U.S. that visited India for discussions on customs and trade facilitation in the first week of November,” he said. “The discussions went off in a very positive direction. A lot of issues were closed, and there was convergence in a lot of areas.” In addition, he said that the chief negotiators of both sides regularly speak with each other virtually to carry forward the discussions and “iron out some of the language issues or some of the small fixes that remain in the agreement”. 在印度与美国临时贸易协议即将取得重大进展之际，印度工商部一名高级官员表示，美国已向印度保证，待其最终确定关税结构后，印度将相对其竞争对手享有比较优势；双方正努力在本财政年度结束前完成协议。

印度官员多次表示，只有美国保证印度相对其竞争对手享有比较优势，印度才会推进协议。2026年2月，印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普发表的联合声明中曾就此达成一致。

此外，商务秘书拉杰什·阿格罗沃尔证实，美国派出了一个两人代表团，于本月早些时候访问印度，双方在敲定协议文本方面取得了实质进展。

这名高级官员在匿名条件下表示：“印度与美国之间的谈判仍在进行，美国已向我们保证，相对竞争国家，我们将享有比较优势。”由于双方双边讨论的细节尚未公开，他要求匿名。

这是一项重大进展。印度官员，包括商务部长皮尤什·戈亚尔在内，多次表示，只有美国保证印度相对其竞争对手享有比较优势，印度才会推进与美国的协议。

2月发表的联合声明称，美国和印度“承诺持续在各自关注的相关领域为彼此提供优惠市场准入”。然而，自那以后，美国对印度额外征收了10%的“强迫劳动”关税，对印度尼西亚、马来西亚、巴基斯坦和斯里兰卡等一些竞争对手也征收了同样税率的关税。

此外，美国目前正就产能过剩问题对印度及其他几个国家展开另一项调查，未来可能征收额外关税。不过，该官员表示，美国向印度作出的比较优势保证已考虑这项未来可能征收的关税。

该官员补充说：“双方的目標是在本财政年度结束前完成协议。我们还同意加入一项条款：如果其中任何一国调整对另一国的关税，另一国也可以修改其在协议中的承诺。2月的联合声明中也包含了这一内容。”

该官员表示，此类条款在印度参与签订的交易中“并不常见”，但这次却专门纳入了印度与美国的协议。

阿格罗沃尔先生另行表示，双方谈判“方向正确”，各团队正通过线下和线上方式开展磋商。

他说：“11月第一周，美国派出一个小代表团访问印度，讨论海关和贸易便利化事宜。讨论进展非常积极，许多问题得到解决，双方在许多领域达成了共识。”

他还表示，双方首席谈判代表经常通过线上方式交流，以推进讨论，并“解决协议中残留的一些措辞问题或一些小幅修改事项”。

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body: The Bayelsa State Government has announced a partnership with a United States-based energy company to develop a gas processing facility, but the value of the proposed investment is yet to be determined, pending a feasibility assessment of gas flare sites across the state. The government said the agreement with Fulcrum LNG Incorporated was reached on Wednesday at the inaugural US-Nigeria Governors Government-to-Business (G2B) Forum on Energy, Mining and Infrastructure in Sugar Land, Texas. The announcement came after a meeting between Governor Douye Diri and the company’s Chief Executive Officer, Jesus Bronchalo. According to a statement issued by the governor’s spokesperson, Daniel Alabrah, the project will be implemented in phases, beginning with the gathering and commercialisation of gas currently being flared. The gas is expected to supply Bayelsa’s Independent Power Plant and emerging industrial clusters, while reducing environmental pollution associated with gas flaring. A subsequent phase will involve an integrated gas monetisation and development plan to harness the state’s gas reserves. However, the financial commitment to the Bayelsa project remains unclear. Although the government publicised the deal as a $100 million investment, Mr Bronchalo said the actual investment requirement would only be determined after a comprehensive field study of the state’s flare sites. He said the assessment would determine the locations of the facilities, the volume of gas being flared and whether the problem resulted from inadequate infrastructure to transport the gas or insufficient reinjection capacity. Mr Bronchalo also cautioned that some flare sites could be too remote or economically unviable for gas gathering. He said the company would finance the project entirely, although the state government would have to contribute capital if it wanted an equity stake. The company’s chief executive said the period from the final investment decision to commissioning would be about 12 months. He cited a similar project the company is undertaking in Guyana, which he valued at about $3 billion, as an indication of its experience in gas infrastructure development. Fulcrum LNG was selected by the Guyanese government in June 2024 to help develop gas infrastructure for the monetisation of the country’s natural gas resources. The selection followed a competitive process involving 17 bidders. The Guyana project was intended to involve the design, financing, construction and operation of gas infrastructure, although its development has faced questions about financing and implementation. PREMIUM TIMES sent a media enquiry to Mr Alabrah, seeking clarification on the reported $100 million investment, the status of the agreement, Fulcrum LNG’s financial commitment, the gas flare sites identified for the project and the proposed ownership and funding arrangements. Mr Alabrah, in a text message to PREMIUM TIMES, said there was no cause for alarm and that Westpaq International, the facilitator of the deal, would respond to the newspaper’s questions. He said he had forwarded the enquiry to the company’s chief executive officer and promised to provide further information once he received a response. The newspaper had yet to receive a response as of the time of filing this report. Responding to the agreement, Mr Diri described the partnership as a win-win arrangement, saying it was important to reducing environmental pollution and supporting industrialisation. He said his administration was ready to facilitate the project’s commencement, noting that it had about 15 months remaining in office. Earlier, during his presentation at the forum, the governor said Bayelsa holds an estimated 15 to 20 per cent of Nigeria’s proven gas reserves and supplies about 60 per cent of the gas used by Nigeria LNG Limited in Bonny, Rivers State. He also highlighted the state’s 203-kilometre Atlantic coastline and the proposed Agge Deep Seaport as investment opportunities. The forum, facilitated by Westpaq International in collaboration with the United States Department of Commerce and the US Commercial Service in Houston, brought together representatives of Bayelsa, Nasarawa, Ogun and Ondo states and more than 15 American energy, mining and financial companies. The Bayelsa delegation included the governor’s Honourary Adviser on Oil and Gas, Daru Owei; Managing Director of Bayelsa State Electricity Company, Olice Kemenanabo; Director-General of Bayelsa Investment Promotion Agency, Patience Abah; and Chief Executive Officer of Century Energy Group, Ken Etete
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.title_zh: 巴耶尔萨州宣布与美国达成天然气工厂协议，但投资金额仍不确定
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body_zh: 巴耶尔萨州政府已宣布与一家总部位于美国的能源公司达成合作，将开发一座天然气处理设施，但在对该州各地天然气燃烧点进行可行性评估之前，拟议投资的价值仍无法确定。政府表示，与Fulcrum LNG Incorporated的协议于周三在得克萨斯州舒格兰举行的首届美尼州长政府与商业论坛能源、矿业和基础设施分会期间达成。此前，州长Douye Diri曾与该公司首席执行官Jesus Bronchalo会面。根据州长发言人Daniel Alabrah发表的声明，该项目将分阶段实施，首先收集并商业化利用目前正在燃烧的天然气。这些天然气预计将供应巴耶尔萨州的独立发电厂和新兴产业集群，同时减少天然气燃烧带来的环境污染。后续阶段将制定综合天然气变现与开发计划，以利用该州的天然气储备。然而，州政府尚未明确对该项目承诺的资金规模。尽管政府对外宣称这笔投资为1亿美元，但Bronchalo先生表示，只有在对该州天然气燃烧点进行全面实地研究后，才能确定实际投资需求。他说，评估将确定设施选址、正在燃烧的天然气量，以及问题究竟源于天然气运输基础设施不足，还是回注能力不足。Bronchalo先生还警告称，部分燃烧点可能过于偏远，或在经济上不具备天然气收集条件。他说，该公司将全额资助该项目，但州政府如希望持有股权，则必须注资。该公司首席执行官表示，从最终投资决定到投产大约需要12个月。他援引该公司在圭亚那实施的类似项目作为其天然气基础设施开发经验的证明，并称该项目估值约30亿美元。2024年6月，圭亚那政府选定Fulcrum LNG协助开发天然气基础设施，以变现该国天然气资源。此次遴选经过有17家投标人参与的竞争程序。圭亚那项目原计划涉及天然气基础设施的设计、融资、建设和运营，但其开发进程在融资和实施方面受到质疑。PREMIUM TIMES向Alabrah先生发出媒体问询，要求澄清有关1亿美元投资的报道、协议进展、Fulcrum LNG的资金承诺、项目所选定的天然气燃烧点，以及拟议的股权和资金安排。Alabrah先生通过短信回复PREMIUM TIMES称，没有必要惊慌，交易协调方Westpaq International将答复该报的问题。他说，已将问询转交给该公司的首席执行官，并承诺在收到答复后提供更多信息。截至本报道发稿时，该报尚未收到答复。针对这项协议，Diri先生将双方合作描述为互利共赢安排，称其对减少环境污染和支持工业化十分重要。他说，其政府已准备为项目启动提供协助，并指出距本届政府任期届满约剩15个月。此前，州长在论坛发言时表示，巴耶尔萨州估计拥有尼日利亚已探明天然气储量的15%至20%，并供应尼日利亚LNG Limited在河流州博尼使用的约60%的天然气。他还强调，该州拥有203公里的大西洋海岸线，拟议中的Agge Deep Seaport也具有投资机会。此次论坛由Westpaq International与美国商务部及美国商务部休斯敦商业服务局合作协调，汇集了巴耶尔萨州、纳萨拉瓦州、奥贡州和翁多州的代表，以及15家以上的美国能源、矿业和金融企业。巴耶尔萨州代表团包括州长石油与天然气事务荣誉顾问Daru Owei、巴耶尔萨州电力公司董事总经理Olice Kemenanabo、巴耶尔萨州投资促进局局长Patience Abah，以及Century Energy Group首席执行官Ken Etete

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: The remains of two Korean independence fighters laid to rest in the United States and Uzbekistan will return home next week to mark the 80th anniversary of a project to repatriate the remains of such activists from overseas, the veterans ministry said Friday. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 韩国退伍军人部周五表示，安葬在美国和乌兹别克斯坦的两位韩国独立运动人士遗骸将于下周回国，以纪念从海外迎回此类活动人士遗骸项目实施80周年。这标志着安葬在乌兹别克斯坦的独立运动人士遗骸首次回国。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The remains of two Korean independence fighters laid to rest in the United States and Uzbekistan will return home next week to mark the 80th anniversary of a project to repatriate the remains of such activists from overseas, the veterans ministry said Friday. The remains of Ho Si-han and Lee Gwal will be brought back from the U.S. and Uzbekistan, respectively, on Sunday, according to the ministry. It marks the first time that the remains of an independence fighter buried in Uzbekistan will return home. An event marking their return will be held at a memorial park in Seoul on Monday, attended by some 300 personnel, and the remains will later be buried at the national cemetery in the central city of Daejeon. Ho, born in Seoul in 1885, was arrested by the Japanese police while raising military funds following the March 1 independence movement against Japan's 1910-45 colonial rule of Korea. He also took part in a number of fundraising schemes to support the Korean independence movement from 1927 to 1945, before he died in Los Angeles in 1956. The Korean government posthumously awarded him the Aejok Order of Merit for National Foundation in 2021 over his role in the country's independence. Lee, born in North Hamgyong Province in 1898, moved to Manchuria and actively participated in Korean national organizations in Russia's far eastern region of Primorsky Krai in 1919. He also served as the diplomatic delegate of the Korean Provisional Government in the early 1920s, but he was later deported to Uzbekistan in 1937, where he died. Lee was awarded the National Foundation Medal in 2009. The repatriation comes as part of civilian and government-led efforts that began with the return of the remains of three renowned Korean independence fighters, including Yun Bong-gil, in 1946 and have continued for 80 years. Meanwhile, the ministry has identified 240 tombs in total of Korean independence fighters buried across 10 countries, including China, the U.S. and Kazakhstan, and plans to bring their remains back home after consulting with their bereaved families. The veterans ministry said 158 sets of remains of independence fighters have been so far repatriated from 14 countries

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国 veterans ministry 周五表示，两名分别安葬在美国和乌兹别克斯坦的韩国独立运动人士的遗骸将于下周回国，以纪念从海外迎回此类活动人士遗骸计划80周年。据该部透露，Ho Si-han和Lee Gwal的遗骸将分别于周日从美国和乌兹别克斯坦运回。这是首次迎回一位安葬在乌兹别克斯坦的独立运动人士遗骸。纪念他们归国的活动将于周一在首尔的一座纪念公园举行，约有300人参加，随后遗骸将被安葬在大田市中心的国家公墓。Ho于1885年出生于首尔，在日本殖民统治朝鲜的1910年至1945年间，他曾参加反对日本殖民统治的3月1日独立运动并筹集军费，后被日本警察逮捕。1927年至1945年间，他还参与了多项支持韩国独立运动的筹款活动，之后于1956年在洛杉矶去世。鉴于他在韩国独立事业中的贡献，韩国政府于2021年追授他爱国建国勋章。Lee于1898年出生于朝鲜咸镜北道，1919年移居满洲，并积极参与俄罗斯远东滨海边疆区的韩国人组织。20世纪20年代初，他还担任韩国临时政府的外交代表，但后来于1937年被驱逐至乌兹别克斯坦，并在那里去世。Lee于2009年获颁建国勋章。这次迎回遗骸是民间和政府共同推动的工作的一部分；该工作始于1946年迎回包括Yun Bong-gil在内的三名著名韩国独立运动人士遗骸，并持续了80年。与此同时，该部已在包括中国、美国和哈萨克斯坦在内的10个国家确认了240处韩国独立运动人士墓葬，并计划在与遇难者家属协商后将其遗骸迎回国内。韩国 veterans ministry 表示，截至目前，已从14个国家迎回158具独立运动人士遗骸

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Korea's rice output declined for the fifth consecutive year in 2026 amid changing dietary habits, data showed Friday, with the cultivation area also reaching a new low. Rice production decreased 0.9 percent year-on-year to 3.5 million tons this year, according to data compiled by the Ministry of Data and Statistics. It marked the fourth-lowest level since the government began compiling the data in 1965. The combined area of rice paddies in the country fell 1.1 percent year-on-year to 670,000 hectares, the smallest on record. Despite the decline in overall production, output per 1,000 square meters increased 0.2 percent year-on-year to 524 kilograms this year, according to the ministry. Rice remains a staple food in Korea, but consumption has steadily fallen in recent decades amid shifts in dietary preferences. The decrease in production also came amid the government's efforts to manage output while encouraging farmers to switch to other crops. By region, South Jeolla Province and Gwangju together produced 736,000 tons of rice, followed by South Chungcheong Province with 681,000 tons and North Jeolla Province with 526,000 tons, the government findings showed

Unlock these with Subscription Senior Congress leader and MP Shashi Tharoor has alleged that 115 of the 315 speakers invited to the second edition of the Bharat Summit in Hyderabad were denied entry into India or had their visas cancelled, “apparently on the instructions of the Union Ministry of Home Affairs”. Mr. Tharoor, who is in Hyderabad for the Bharat Summit, in a post on social media platforms, questioned the legal basis for the action and said it was unclear under which provision of law the government had taken such a step. He pointed out that the summit would conclude on Saturday (November 14, 2026), making it impossible to reverse the decision in time for the affected participants to attend. “What a shame that a proud democracy has become so insecure that it must stifle any voices it fears will be critical!” he wrote. His allegations came in the wake of a Norwegian journalist Helle Lyng claiming that she had been advised by the Indian Embassy not to travel to India despite holding a valid visa to participate in the summit. She works for the Oslo-based newspaper Dagsavisen. Earlier, Congress MP and Telangana Congress media in-charge Chamala Kiran Kumar Reddy had also alleged that nearly 30% of the invitees could not travel to India because of visa-related issues. Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi is scheduled to participate in the valedictory session on Saturday. The controversy has raised questions over the participation of international delegates at the two-day summit, which seeks to bring together nearly 1,000 participants from India and around 70 countries. The event is being held against the backdrop of the 80th year of India’s Independence and the 137th birth anniversary of the country’s first Prime Minister, Jawaharlal Nehru. Mr. Tharoor said the summit would also focus on establishing a think tank, ‘Our World Institute’, and creating a platform for dialogue and cooperation between the Global South and the Global North. The allegations come amid political controversy over the event, with the BJP calling it an “anti-India summit” and accusing Mr. Gandhi of giving a platform to forces opposed to the country’s interests. BJP leaders in Telangana have announced plans to protest against his visit to Hyderabad. Union Coal Minister G. Kishan Reddy, addressing a press conference in New Delhi on Thursday, termed the Bharat Summit an “anti-India summit”. The BJP alleged the event was meant to bring together forces critical of India and questioned the Congress leadership’s motives for organising it. Telangana BJP president N. Ramchander Rao questioned the rationale behind holding such an event in the State when the government was facing financial constraints. He accused Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy of spending public money to sponsor what he described as anti-India forces, in order to please Mr. Rahul Gandhi. The BJP’s criticism has added a political dimension to the controversy surrounding the summit, particularly following allegations that several international speakers and invitees were unable to travel to India because of visa-related issues. https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/t.title_zh: 沙希·塔鲁尔称115名“印度 Bharat 峰会”发言人被禁止入境，签证也被取消
https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/t.body_zh:
订阅账户还可享受《Premium Stories》、社论、观点等更多内容。订阅即可解锁这些权益。

资深国会议党领袖兼议员沙希·塔鲁尔称，在海得拉巴举行的第二届 Bharat Summit 邀请了315名发言人，其中115人被拒绝入境印度或签证遭取消，“显然是根据联邦内政部的指示”。塔鲁尔先生目前正在海得拉巴参加 Bharat Summit。他在社交媒体平台发文，质疑这一行动的法律依据，并表示不清楚政府依据法律中的哪一项条款采取了这一措施。他指出，峰会将于星期六（2026年11月14日）闭幕，因此受影响者不可能及时推翻这一决定并参会。他写道：“一个引以为豪的民主国家竟变得如此缺乏安全感，以至于必须压制任何它认为可能提出批评的声音，真是可悲！”

这些指控是在挪威记者 Helle Lyng 声称自己尽管持有参加峰会的有效签证，仍被印度使馆建议不要前往印度之后提出的。她供职于总部位于奥斯陆的报纸《Dagsavisen》。此前，国会议员兼特伦甘纳邦国大党媒体负责人 Chamala Kiran Kumar Reddy 也曾指控，近30%的受邀者因签证相关问题无法赴印度。

人民院反对党领袖拉胡尔·甘地计划于星期六参加闭幕会议。这场争议引发了对国际代表参与这场为期两天的峰会的疑问。此次峰会旨在汇集来自印度及约70个国家的近1,000名参与者。活动是在印度独立80周年暨该国首任总理贾瓦哈拉尔·尼赫鲁诞辰137周年的背景下举行的。

塔鲁尔先生表示，峰会还将重点关注成立一个名为“Our World Institute”的智库，并搭建全球南方与全球北方之间的对话与合作平台。

这些指控出现之际，该活动正引发政治争议。印度人民党称其为“反印度峰会”，并指责甘地先生为反对国家利益的势力提供平台。印度人民党在特伦甘纳邦的领导人宣布计划抗议他访问海得拉巴。联邦煤炭部长 G. Kishan Reddy 星期四在新德里举行的新闻发布会上称 Bharat Summit 是“反印度峰会”。印度人民党声称，该活动旨在召集批评印度的势力，并质疑国大党领导层举办此次活动的动机。

特伦甘纳邦印度人民党主席 N. Ramchander Rao 质疑，在政府面临财政约束的情况下在该邦举办此类活动的原因。他指责首席部长 A. Revanth Reddy 花费公共资金赞助他所谓的反印度势力，以取悦拉胡尔·甘地先生。

在多名国际发言人和受邀者因签证相关问题无法赴印度的指控之后，印度人民党的批评又为围绕此次峰会的争议增添了政治层面的争论。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: Foreign Minister Cho Hyun departed for China on Friday for talks with his Chinese counterpart, Wang Yi, on bilateral relations and issues concerning the Korean Peninsula, including the possibility of renewed dialogue between Washington and Pyongyang. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 外交部长赵显星期五启程前往中国，与中国外交部长王毅就双边关系及朝鲜半岛问题举行会谈，其中包括华盛顿与平壤恢复对话的可能性。根据外交部的消息，赵显计划于当天晚些时候与王毅会谈，随后出席中国外交部长主持的晚宴。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Foreign Minister Cho Hyun departed for China on Friday for talks with his Chinese counterpart, Wang Yi, on bilateral relations and issues concerning the Korean Peninsula, including the possibility of renewed dialogue between Washington and Pyongyang. Cho was scheduled to hold talks with Wang later in the day, followed by a dinner hosted by the Chinese foreign minister, according to the foreign ministry. "We plan to discuss the overall state of bilateral relations, particularly issues that need to be coordinated between the two countries ahead of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit," Cho told reporters at Gimpo International Airport before departing for China. His visit comes ahead of President Lee Jae Myung's planned trip to China for the APEC summit in Shenzhen from Wednesday to Thursday, and the ministerial meeting was expected to help lay the groundwork for a potential meeting between Lee and Chinese President Xi Jinping. "We plan to hold comprehensive discussions with China on these issues, particularly North Korea-related matters, including the possibility of U.S.-North Korea talks," Cho added. There has been speculation about a possible meeting between U.S. President Donald Trump and North Korean leader Kim Jong-un during Trump's trip to Asia, as the U.S. president has expressed interest in resuming dialogue with Pyongyang. Asked whether he believes China is willing to mediate between Washington and Pyongyang, Cho expressed uncertainty over how actively Beijing might pursue such efforts. "I don't think there is much chance of China actively inviting (Kim) to the APEC summit for talks, but it is still too early to tell," the minister said. Wang accompanied Xi during his visit to the U.S. in August. The Chinese foreign minister was also present during Kim's surprise visit to the Chinese border city of Dandong last month. He also met with Kim Song-nam, a senior ruling Workers' Party official, in Beijing last week. A South Korean presidential official said Thursday that a meeting between Trump and Kim on the sidelines of the APEC summit was unlikely, while noting that it was difficult to predict whether contact between the two leaders might take place before or after the summit. China's foreign ministry said Thursday that Beijing attaches great importance to Cho's visit and is willing to work with Seoul to implement important agreements reached by the two countries' leaders. Cho's visit follows an invitation from Wang during their talks in Seoul in August. At the time, the two ministers exchanged views on bilateral relations and Korean Peninsula issues, with Cho calling for Beijing to play a constructive role in bringing North Korea back to dialogue. Cho plans to return home Saturday after holding a meeting with Korean correspondents in China, officials said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 赵兑烈赴中国与王毅会谈，讨论双边关系及朝美对话前景
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 韩国外交部长赵显周五启程前往中国，与中国外长王毅就双边关系及朝鲜半岛问题举行会谈，其中包括华盛顿与平壤重启对话的可能性。据韩国外交部介绍，赵显当天晚些时候将与王毅会谈，随后出席由中国外长主持的晚宴。赵显在金浦国际机场启程前往中国前对记者说：“我们计划讨论双边关系的总体状况，尤其是亚太经合组织（APEC）峰会前两国需要协调的议题。”赵显此访是在李在明总统计划于周三至周四赴深圳出席亚太经合组织峰会之前进行的；此次部长级会议预计将为李在明与中国国家主席习近平可能举行的会晤铺路。赵显补充说：“我们计划就这些问题与中国进行全面讨论，尤其是与朝鲜有关的事务，包括美朝会谈的可能性。”在特朗普亚洲之行期间，外界一直猜测美国总统特朗普与朝鲜领导人金正恩可能会面，因为特朗普已表示有兴趣恢复与平壤的对话。当被问及是否认为中国愿意在华盛顿与平壤之间进行调解时，赵显对北京会多积极地推动此类努力表示不确定。他说：“我认为，中国主动邀请（金正恩）参加亚太经合组织峰会并举行会谈的可能性不大，但现在下结论还为时过早。”今年8月习近平访问美国期间，王毅陪同习近平出访。中国外长上个月还陪同金正恩突然访问中国边境城市丹东。上周，他还在北京会见了朝鲜执政党劳动党高级官员金正南。韩国总统府官员周四表示，特朗普与金正恩在亚太经合组织峰会期间会面的可能性不大，同时指出，难以预测两位领导人是否会在峰会前或峰会后接触。中国外交部周四表示，北京高度重视赵显此次访问，并愿与首尔合作落实两国领导人达成的重要协议。赵显此次访问源于王毅8月在首尔会谈时发出的邀请。当时，两位外长就双边关系和朝鲜半岛问题交换了意见，赵显呼吁北京在推动朝鲜重返对话方面发挥建设性作用。官员表示，赵显计划于周六在中国与驻华韩国记者举行会面后回国。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary: WASHINGTON — The FBI said Thursday that it had seized more than $1.2 billion of cryptocurrency reported stolen last month from Binance , the world's largest crypto exchange. The theft of about $6.3 billion from Binance is regarded as the biggest crypto heist in history, and the FBI has previously attributed it to a North Korean hacking group known as TraderTraitor.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary_zh: 华盛顿——美国联邦调查局（FBI）周四表示，已查扣据报上月从全球最大加密货币交易所币安被盗的超过12亿美元加密资产。币安约63亿美元被盗案被视为史上规模最大的加密货币盗窃案，FBI此前将其归咎于一个名为TraderTraitor的朝鲜黑客组织。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: WASHINGTON — The FBI said Thursday that it had seized more than $1.2 billion of cryptocurrency reported stolen last month from Binance , the world's largest crypto exchange. The theft of about $6.3 billion from Binance is regarded as the biggest crypto heist in history, and the FBI has previously attributed it to a North Korean hacking group known as TraderTraitor. The U.S. government and private sector have so far combined to freeze more than $2.7 billion of the stolen funds, and the Justice Department said Thursday that it has now obtained court authorization to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion of that total. Typically in those situations, the U.S. government will file a claim of forfeiture with a judge, who will then determine who has a legitimate claim to the recovered funds. Also Thursday, the FBI blamed North Korea for a separate social engineering scheme that officials say resulted in the theft of $400 million worth of cryptocurrency over the last 18 months. That scheme, known as FaceStealer, involves a complicated chain of events combining the hijacking of popular messaging apps and the recording of deepfake videos. U.S. officials have repeatedly accused North Korea of using cyber schemes to generate funds for its regime, including its illicit weapons program
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: FBI称，美国已查扣从Binance窃取的价值12亿美元加密货币

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: WASHINGTON — The U.S. House of Representatives has passed a bill aimed at protecting American small businesses from economic and cybersecurity threats posed by foreign adversaries, including North Korea. The House passed the Combating Foreign Threats to Main Street Act of 2026 on Wednesday, The bill would require the Small Business Administration (SBA) to provide small businesses with information and guidance on identifying and responding to threats from foreign adversaries. "China, Russia and North Korea are working to undermine our economic and national security, and American businesses are increasingly caught in the crosshairs," Rep. Roger Williams (R-TX) said during a House floor debate on Wednesday. The legislation seeks to help businesses address risks such as intellectual property theft, cyberattacks, counterfeit goods and predatory investment practices. It now subject to deliberation by the Senate. "While these threats affect businesses of every size, small businesses are often the most vulnerable, and they simply do not have the resources or expertise to identify these threats and protect themselves," Williams said. Under the bill, the SBA would be required to review its educational materials annually starting in October 2027 and notify relevant congressional committees of certain activities posing significant risks to U.S. economic or national security interests
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 美国众议院通过法案，保护小企业免受外国对手侵害，包括朝鲜
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 华盛顿——美国众议院通过了一项法案，旨在保护美国小型企业，使其免受外国对手（包括朝鲜）带来的经济威胁和网络安全威胁。众议院于周三通过了《2026年应对外国对主街威胁法案》。根据该法案，美国小企业管理局（SBA）必须向小型企业提供相关信息和指导，帮助其识别并应对外国对手的威胁。众议员罗杰·威廉姆斯（共和党，得克萨斯州）在周三的众议院辩论中说：“中国、俄罗斯和朝鲜正试图破坏我们的经济和国家安全，美国企业日益成为他们的目标。”该法案旨在帮助企业应对知识产权盗窃、网络攻击、假冒商品和掠夺性投资行为等风险。该法案现交由参议院审议。威廉姆斯说：“虽然这些威胁影响着各种规模的企业，但小型企业往往最为脆弱，而且它们根本不具备识别这些威胁并保护自身所需的资源或专业能力。”根据该法案，从2027年10月起，美国小企业管理局每年都必须审查其教育材料，并将美国经济或国家安全利益面临重大风险的某些活动通报给相关国会委员会

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.title: China's memory makers are catching up. What happens when they do?
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.summary: CXMT and Yangtze Memory Technologies (YMTC) are the twin pillars of China’s drive for memory self-sufficiency, part of Beijing’s broader pursuit of technological independence facing U.S. export restrictions. CXMT, founded in Hefei, capital city of China’s eastern Anhui province, in 2016, has become the world’s fourth-largest producer of DRAM, the working memory used in computers and smartphones.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.summary_zh: 长鑫存储和长江存储（YMTC）是中国实现存储芯片自主化的两大支柱，也是北京在美国实施出口限制之际推进更广泛技术独立的组成部分。长鑫存储于2016年在中国东部安徽省省会合肥成立，现已成为全球第四大DRAM生产商。DRAM是计算机和智能手机使用的工作内存。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body: The memory business has rarely had it this good, thanks to the artificial intelligence (AI) boom. Korea’s chipmakers are reporting extraordinary earnings and unusual confidence that the good times will last. SK hynix’s third-quarter operating profit rose more than sevenfold to 83.3 trillion won ($62 billion), an operating margin of almost 80 percent. Samsung Electronics’ rose nearly ninefold to 107.4 trillion won, with its memory business setting records of its own. Across the West Sea, China’s challengers are sharing in the windfall. ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) remains far smaller, but its quarterly revenue rose more than sevenfold to 118.7 billion yuan ($17.8 billion), with a net profit attributable to shareholders of 54.4 billion yuan, reversing years of losses. CXMT and Yangtze Memory Technologies (YMTC) are the twin pillars of China’s drive for memory self-sufficiency, part of Beijing’s broader pursuit of technological independence facing U.S. export restrictions. Fresh capital, new factories and increasingly sophisticated technology are helping them challenge the overseas incumbents that have long dominated the industry. The remaining tech gap is “hard to close,” according to Laila Khawaja, research director at Gavekal Technologies. She expects Chinese and non-Chinese memory markets to diverge in supply chains and technology paths, but sees Chinese suppliers’ gains at home spilling over into global pricing and bargaining power. “Chinese suppliers do not need to flood overseas markets to create that pressure,” she said. CXMT, founded in Hefei, capital city of China’s eastern Anhui province, in 2016, has become the world’s fourth-largest producer of DRAM, the working memory used in computers and smartphones. Its share of global DRAM revenue reached 9 percent in the third quarter of 2026, up from 5 percent a year earlier, Counterpoint Research's latest data shows. Government funding helped finance its entry into the capital-intensive industry. The memory boom is now funding its ramp-up: revenue rose more than eightfold to 269 billion yuan in the first nine months of 2026. Its blockbuster Shanghai IPO in July raised 66.6 billion yuan, the biggest in Asia of the year. Morgan Stanley estimates that CXMT’s monthly wafer-processing capacity could reach 500,000 by 2028, roughly 15 percent of the global DRAM total, with bit shipments growing at a compound annual rate of 40 percent between 2025 and 2028. CXMT is also moving up the technology ladder. At an earnings briefing on Oct. 30, the company highlighted it had begun mass production using its fifth-generation process, which it claims produces at least 50 percent more chips per wafer than its predecessor. CXMT also said it had validated prototypes using its sixth-generation 4F2 design, which could theoretically shrink memory cells by a third compared with conventional layouts. It plans to send customers samples of server memory modules using the technology by year-end. YMTC, founded in Wuhan the same year with central and provincial state backing, has made similar strides in NAND flash, which retains data without power. By the second quarter of 2026, it ranked third globally by shipment volume, with a 16.5 share, ahead of Japan’s Kioxia, according to Counterpoint. “With AI driving the NAND super cycle, YMTC has become the fastest-growing vendor, with prudent investments in capability and capacity despite geopolitical headwinds,” said Choi Jeong-ku, senior analyst at Counterpoint Research, noting that the chipmaker’s revenue in 2026 is bound to grow six times faster than the industry and its peers. Its strength lies partly in Xtacking, an architecture unveiled in 2018 that builds memory cells and their control circuitry on separate wafers before bonding them together. This allows denser storage and faster data transfer. Samsung has licensed YMTC’s hybrid-bonding patents and SK hynix was also said to be in talks, local media outlets reported, while Micron faces patent infringement lawsuits brought by the Chinese company. YMTC is seeking 33 billion yuan through a Shanghai listing without a clear timeline.It reported a first-quarter net profit of 33.4 billion yuan — more than twice its earnings for all of 2025, prospectus shows. Equipment orders tell the same story. Advanced Micro-Fabrication Equipment China (AMEC), which makes tools that etch microscopic structures into chips, booked record orders in the first nine months of 2026, with memory manufacturers accounting for about 60 percent. The harder test is turning those advances into chips that can be made reliably, at competitive cost and in volume. CXMT’s earlier announcement on 4F2 rattled investors, sending shares in SK hynix, Samsung and Micron tumbling that day, although broader concerns over AI spending also weighed on the sector. However, its rivals were more circumspect. SK hynix said it would keep extending its proven 6F2 architecture before switching to a new design. “The timing of technological development and the timing of commercialization are distinct from each other,” management said during its third-quarter earnings call. Samsung is also developing 4F2. Micron has excluded it from its road map, arguing that smaller transistor layouts do not necessarily improve density and the capacitors that store electrical charge remain the limiting factor. Nomura expects CXMT’s 4F2 chips to reach volume production only in 2027-28, and estimates that its manufacturing technology still trails the leaders by at least three years. “CXMT remains about two generations behind the industry leaders,” Macquarie’s Daniel Kim wrote in an October report. He estimates its conventional DRAM process delivers only about 65 percent as much memory per wafer as the industry’s leading processes. The divide is wider in high-bandwidth memory (HBM), which stacks DRAM chips to feed data rapidly to AI processors. “CXMT remains primarily a conventional DRAM maker, and is not yet capable of mass-producing HBM profitably,” Khawaja said. Its preceding DRAM platform still falls short of mature industry yields — the proportion of working chips — of 85-90 percent, she estimates. YMTC is closer to the leaders in NAND, but still trails by about a generation in cutting-edge layer counts. Adding more layers requires equipment capable of etching ever deeper, narrower structures through the stack — another area where Chinese toolmakers lag. Equipment remains a central constraint for both companies. Beyond gaps in technology, manufacturing know-how and research talent, domestic toolmakers face “patent walls, not to mention the rigorous validation period required and the high requirement for tool stability,” Khawaja said. “My base case remains further erosion of foreign suppliers’ market share in China,” Khawaja said. That displacement can affect global prices even without Chinese chips leaving the country. The first openings are in mainstream memory for smartphones, PCs and storage, supported by Beijing’s localization mandates for state-backed users and Chinese companies’ efforts to hedge against supply risks, she said. As established manufacturers prioritize AI products, shortages are also prompting customers outside China to qualify Chinese alternatives. Once qualified, Chinese suppliers can gain a foothold as second or third sources, which “could affect the big three's [Samsung, SK Hynix, Micron] bargaining power over the long run,” she said. The pressure will be uneven. CXMT poses a more immediate challenge in conventional DRAM than advanced HBM, where the manufacturing gap remains wide. YMTC’s push into enterprise SSDs could bring it into closer competition with industry leader Samsung in higher-value data center storage. Counterpoint Research expects server-related products to generate nearly 39 percent of its revenue by 2028, up from virtually nothing in 2024. “The bigger question is whether YMTC can convert this into design wins with customers outside China, not just domestic hyperscalers,” said MS Hwang, a research director at Counterpoint. The greater medium-term risk is that AI demand slows after new capacity comes online, Khawaja said. That could push incumbents to redirect DRAM capacity towards conventional products, where stronger Chinese competition could weaken their pricing power. Equipment constraints make an imminent China-driven glut unlikely, she added. For memory chipmakers, prosperity usually arrives with an expiry date. Rising prices finance new factories; the factories produce a glut; the glut destroys the profits that built them. AI has interrupted the cycle. SK hynix expects demand to outstrip supply through 2030. For the boom to last, AI customers must keep spending faster than chipmakers can add usable capacity. Industry analysts disagree over how durable those supply constraints will prove. Morgan Stanley’s Shawn Kim argues that supply will eventually catch up. “Structurally higher AI secular growth riding on top of a cycle... is still a cycle,” he wrote in an October note
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.title_zh: 中国存储芯片制造商正在追赶。等他们追上后会发生什么？
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body_zh: 受益于人工智能（AI）热潮，存储芯片行业许久未曾如此景气。韩国芯片制造商正报告非凡的盈利，并罕见地对好日子的持续充满信心。SK hynix第三季度营业利润增长逾七倍，达到83.3万亿韩元（620亿美元），营业利润率接近80%。Samsung Electronics营业利润增长近九倍，达到107.4万亿韩元，其存储业务也创下自身纪录。在黄海另一边，中国的挑战者也在分享这场意外之财。ChangXin Memory Technologies（CXMT）规模仍小得多，但其季度营收增长逾七倍，达到1187亿元人民币（178亿美元），归属于股东的净利润达到544亿元，扭转了多年的亏损。CXMT和Yangtze Memory Technologies（YMTC）是中国推动存储芯片自给自足的两大支柱，也是北京在美国出口限制下追求更广泛技术自主的一部分。新增资本、新建工厂和日益先进的技术，正帮助它们挑战长期主导该行业的海外 incumbents。Gavekal Technologies研究主管Laila Khawaja表示，剩余的技术差距“很难弥合”。她预计，中国和非中国存储市场将在供应链和技术路径上分化，但认为中国供应商在国内取得的进展将外溢至全球定价和议价能力。她说：“中国供应商无需向海外市场倾销产品，就能形成这种压力。”CXMT于2016年在中国东部安徽省省会合肥成立，如今已成为全球第四大DRAM生产商。DRAM是计算机和智能手机使用的工作存储器。Counterpoint Research最新数据显示，2026年第三季度，CXMT占全球DRAM营收的9%，高于一年前的5%。政府资金帮助其进入这一资本密集型行业。如今，存储芯片热潮正为CXMT的产能爬坡提供资金：2026年前九个月，其营收增长逾八倍，达到2690亿元。其7月在上海进行的巨型IPO募资666亿元，成为当年亚洲规模最大的IPO。Morgan Stanley估计，到2028年，CXMT的晶圆月产能可能达到50万片，约占全球DRAM总量的15%，其比特出货量在2025年至2028年间预计以40%的复合年增长率增长。CXMT也在沿技术阶梯向上攀登。在10月30日的业绩说明会上，该公司强调已利用第五代制程开始量产，并称该制程每片晶圆生产的芯片至少比上一代多50%。CXMT还表示，已验证采用第六代4F2设计的样品；理论上，与传统布局相比，该设计可将存储单元缩小三分之一。公司计划在年底前向客户发送采用这项技术的服务器存储模块样品。YMTC于同年成立于武汉，在中央和省级state支持下，在无需供电即可保存数据的NAND闪存领域也取得了类似进展。据Counterpoint称，到2026年第二季度，YMTC按出货量排名全球第三，市场份额为16.5%，超过日本的Kioxia。Counterpoint Research高级分析师Choi Jeong-ku表示：“在AI推动NAND超级周期之际，尽管面临地缘政治逆风，YMTC仍凭借对能力和产能的审慎投资，成为增长最快的供应商。”他还指出，这家芯片制造商2026年的营收增速预计将比行业及其竞争对手快六倍。YMTC的部分优势来自Xtacking架构。该架构于2018年发布，先在不同的晶圆上构建存储单元及其控制电路，再将两者键合在一起，从而实现更高存储密度和更快数据传输。当地媒体报道称，Samsung已获得YMTC混合键合专利许可，SK hynix据称也在洽谈相关事宜；与此同时，Micron正面临这家中国企业提起的专利侵权诉讼。YMTC正寻求通过在上海上市募资330亿元，但尚无明确时间表。招股说明书显示，其第一季度净利润为334亿元，超过2025年全年利润的两倍。设备订单也印证了同一趋势。Advanced Micro-Fabrication Equipment China（AMEC）生产在芯片上蚀刻 microscopic structures 的设备，2026年前九个月录得创纪录订单，其中约60%来自存储芯片制造商。更艰难的考验，是把这些技术进展转化为能够以有竞争力的成本、可靠且大规模量产的芯片。CXMT早些时候关于4F2的公告曾震动投资者，导致SK hynix、Samsung和Micron股价当日大跌，不过市场对AI支出的更广泛担忧也拖累了整个行业。然而，其竞争对手的态度更为谨慎。SK hynix表示，将在转向新设计前继续延伸其成熟的6F2架构。管理层在第三季度业绩电话会上表示：“技术开发的时点与商业化的时点彼此不同。”Samsung也在开发4F2。Micron则未将其纳入路线图，认为更小的晶体管布局未必能提高密度，而用于储存电荷的电容器仍是限制因素。Nomura预计，CXMT的4F2芯片要到2027—2028年才能实现量产，并估计其制造技术仍落后领先者至少三年。Macquarie的Daniel Kim在10月报告中写道：“CXMT仍落后行业领先者约两代技术。”他估计，CXMT的传统DRAM制程每片晶圆可提供的存储容量仅约为行业领先制程的65%。在高带宽内存（HBM）领域，差距更大。HBM通过堆叠DRAM芯片，为AI处理器快速输送数据。Khawaja说：“CXMT目前主要仍是传统DRAM制造商，尚不能以盈利方式大规模生产HBM。”她估计，CXMT现有DRAM平台的良率——即可用芯片所占比例——仍未达到成熟行业的85%—90%。YMTC在NAND领域更接近领先者，但在最前沿的堆叠层数方面仍落后约一代。增加层数需要能够穿过堆叠结构蚀刻更深、更窄结构的设备，而这也是中国设备制造商落后的领域之一。设备仍是两家公司面临的核心制约。除了技术、制造诀窍和研究人才方面的差距，Khawaja表示，国内设备制造商还面临“专利围墙，更不用说严格的验证周期以及对设备稳定性的高要求”。她表示：“我的基准判断仍是，外国供应商在中国的市场份额将进一步被蚕食。”即使中国芯片不离开本土，这种替代也可能影响全球价格。她说，首个突破口出现在智能手机、PC和存储设备使用的主流存储芯片领域；北京针对受state支持用户的国产化 mandate，以及中国企业规避供应风险的努力，为这一进程提供了助力。随着成熟制造商优先保障AI产品，短缺也在促使中国以外的客户认证中国替代品。一旦通过认证，中国供应商就能作为第二或第三供应来源站稳脚跟，而这“可能从长期影响三巨头[Samsung、SK Hynix、Micron]的议价能力”。压力不会均匀分布。在传统DRAM方面，CXMT构成的挑战比先进HBM更为直接，后者的制造差距仍然很大。YMTC进军企业级SSD，可能使其在价值更高、数据中心存储用量更大的市场与行业龙头Samsung展开更直接竞争。Counterpoint Research预计，到2028年，与服务器相关的产品将贡献YMTC近39%的营收，而2024年这一比例几乎为零。Counterpoint研究主管MS Hwang表示：“更大的问题在于，YMTC能否将这些进展转化为中国以外客户的设计订单，而不只是国内超大规模云服务商的设计订单。”Khawaja说，中期更大的风险是，在新增产能上线后AI需求放缓。这可能促使 incumbents 将DRAM产能转向传统产品，而中国企业在该领域更强的竞争可能削弱其定价能力。她补充称，设备制约使中国很快引发供给过剩的可能性不大。对存储芯片制造商而言，繁荣通常都带着有效期。价格上涨为新工厂提供资金；这些工厂制造出供给过剩；供给过剩又摧毁了支撑它们扩张的利润。AI打断了这一周期。SK hynix预计，到2030年需求都将超过供应。要让繁荣持续，AI客户必须继续以快于芯片制造商新增可用产能的速度投入。行业分析师对供应制约究竟能持续多久存在分歧。Morgan Stanley的Shawn Kim认为，供应最终将追赶上需求。他在10月的一份报告中写道：“结构性更高的AI长期增长叠加于一个周期之上……终究仍是一个周期。”

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/fg-c.body: ABUJA—The Federal Government has signed a 30-year concession agreement for the Port Harcourt International Airport, as part of efforts to attract private investment, improve operational efficiency and unlock the economic potential of the nation’s loss-making airports. Minister of Aviation and Aerospace Development, Mr. Festus Keyamo, disclosed this, yesterday, in Abuja during the signing of the concession agreement with Port Harcourt Airport Company Limited. Keyamo said the concession was aimed at improving the operational efficiency of the airport, boosting revenue generation and unlocking its commercial potential. He explained that the Federal Government has been using profits generated from major airports to subsidise the operations of other airports that were running at a loss. “Some of our airports are being run at a loss. We make so much money from some of our primary airports, and most of those profits are ploughed into running other airports,” Keyamo said. He noted that the concession had the approval of President Bola Tinubu and the Federal Executive Council, adding that the process was not a sudden decision but one that successive administrations had struggled to implement. Keyamo said previous attempts to concession airports were frustrated by resistance from labour unions and court cases involving the government. He, however, attributed the successful conclusion of the process to negotiations with aviation unions, saying the government had secured their agreement before signing the deal. The minister assured workers that the concession would not lead to job losses or a reduction in their conditions of service. He said Tinubu had directed that the welfare of aviation workers must be protected throughout the concession process. “President Bola Tinubu was very concerned about that, that no worker should lose his job. The conditions of service should remain the same,” he said. Keyamo added that the concessionaire would be subjected to performance reviews every five years to ensure compliance with the terms of the agreement. He warned that the government could take back the airport if the concessionaire failed to meet the agreed standards. Comments expressed here do not reflect the opinions of Vanguard newspapers or any employee thereof
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/fg-c.title_zh: 尼日利亚联邦政府将哈科特港机场特许经营权授予企业，为期30年
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/fg-c.body_zh: 阿布贾——联邦政府已签署哈科特国际机场30年期特许经营协议，这是政府为吸引私人投资、提高运营效率并释放全国亏损机场经济潜力而采取的措施。航空与航天发展部长费斯图斯·凯亚莫昨日在阿布贾与哈科特机场有限公司签署特许经营协议时披露了此事。凯亚莫表示，此项特许经营旨在提高机场运营效率、增加收入并释放其商业潜力。他 explained，联邦政府一直利用主要机场创造的利润补贴其他亏损机场的运营。凯亚莫说：“我们的一些机场处于亏损状态。我们从一些主要机场赚到大量资金，而这些利润大部分都用于维持其他机场的运营。”他指出，这项特许经营已获总统博拉·蒂努布和联邦执行委员会批准，并补充说，这并非一项突然作出的决定，历届政府都曾努力推动落实。凯亚莫称，此前推进机场特许经营的尝试因工会抵制以及涉及政府的诉讼而受挫。不过，他将这一进程得以成功完成归功于与航空业工会进行的谈判，称政府在签署协议前已取得工会同意。部长向工作人员保证，特许经营不会导致失业，也不会降低他们的待遇条件。他说，蒂努布已指示在整个特许经营过程中必须保障航空业员工的福祉。凯亚莫说：“总统博拉·蒂努布非常关注此事，确保没有任何员工失去工作，待遇条件应保持不变。”他还补充说，特许经营方每五年都将接受绩效评估，以确保遵守协议条款。他警告，如果特许经营方未达到商定标准，政府可以收回机场经营权。此处发表的意见不代表《Vanguard》报及其任何员工的观点

https://www.myjoyonline.com/govt-plans-3.summary_zh: 政府计划从2027年起，对小规模黄金购买提供3%的折扣，以降低通过国内购金积累外汇和充实储备的成本。该措施载于2027年预算，是将黄金购买计划从加纳银行移交给加纳黄金局后出台的，目前财政部负责为该计划的成本提供资金。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/govt-plans-3.body: The government plans to introduce a 3% discount on small-scale gold purchases in 2027 to reduce the cost of accumulating foreign exchange and building reserves through domestic gold purchases. The measure, outlined in the 2027 Budget, comes after the transfer of the gold-buying programme from the Bank of Ghana to GoldBod, with the Ministry of Finance now responsible for financing its costs. According to the budget, the cost of generating foreign exchange through the Ghana Accelerated National Reserve Accumulation Policy fell from 16% in 2025 to 5% in 2026. Government now intends to reduce it further to 2%. “To reduce this cost further to 2 per cent, Government will, in consultation with industry stakeholders, introduce a 3 per cent discount on small-scale gold purchases in 2027,” the budget states. The proposal addresses an important question raised by the programme’s earlier trading model: whether the price paid for gold leaves enough room to cover export costs and generate foreign exchange. Under the previous arrangement, GoldBod facilitated gold purchases on behalf of the Bank of Ghana, buying from small-scale miners at spot prices and, in some cases, at a premium. GoldBod earned fees for its services, while the central bank financed the purchases and absorbed the associated losses. The Bank of Ghana’s 2025 financial statements reported that the Domestic Gold Purchase Programme generated losses of approximately GH¢22 billion. JoyNews Research subsequently identified several sources of the losses, including service and assay fees, discounts on gold sold to off-takers and exchange-rate differences. Its analysis highlighted the gap between the forex bureau rate used to purchase gold and the reference rate used in the central bank’s accounting. Some losses reflected valuation effects rather than direct economic costs, but they nevertheless weakened the Bank of Ghana’s balance sheet. According to the government, GoldBod began conducting doré gold purchases on April 1, 2026. A memorandum signed in July formalised the transfer of the programme from the Bank of Ghana. In practical terms, the transfer moved the financial burden away from the central bank. It did not automatically make the underlying transactions cheaper. The proposed discount now targets the purchase price itself. Buying gold at a lower price could create more room to cover refining, transport, financing and other trading costs. It could also reduce the amount government needs to provide to support the programme. The government’s own target suggests the discount will reduce the programme’s cost rather than eliminate it. Even after the proposed adjustment, the budget envisages a remaining cost of 2%. The government also has to balance reducing acquisition costs with keeping the official buying system attractive to miners and traders. A lower purchase price could improve the programme’s finances. But its effect on the volume of gold supplied through licensed channels will depend on the prices and payment terms available elsewhere. The budget says the government will develop the measure in consultation with industry stakeholders and specifically calls on the Ghana National Association of Small-Scale Miners and the Licensed Gold Buyers Associations to support the reforms. Government continues to emphasise the programme’s wider benefits. The budget reports that GoldBod has exported 88 tonnes of small-scale gold worth $12 billion since January 2026, supporting foreign-exchange supply, reserve accumulation and the cedi. Those benefits explain why the programme remains important to government. They also make it necessary to report its costs transparently. The 3% discount is a concrete response to the acquisition-cost problem. But transferring responsibility for financing the programme from the Bank of Ghana to the Ministry of Finance does not, in itself, resolve the underlying economics of the transactions
https://www.myjoyonline.com/govt-plans-3.title_zh: 尼日利亚政府接管博茨瓦纳黄金公司的项目成本后，计划对GoldBod的黄金采购提供3%的折扣
https://www.myjoyonline.com/govt-plans-3.body_zh: 政府计划于2027年对小规模黄金采购给予3%的折扣，以降低通过国内采购黄金积累外汇和充实储备的成本。这项措施载于2027年预算，出现在黄金采购计划由加纳央行移交给加纳黄金局之后，目前财政部负责为相关成本提供资金。根据预算，依据《加纳加速国家储备积累政策》创造外汇的成本已从2025年的16%降至2026年的5%。政府现 intends 进一步将其降至2%。预算指出：“为进一步将这一成本降至2%，政府将在与行业利益相关方协商后，于2027年对小规模黄金采购给予3%的折扣。”该提案回应了此前交易模式提出的一个重要问题：黄金收购价格能否留出足够空间，以覆盖出口成本并创造外汇。在此前安排下，加纳黄金局代表加纳央行促成黄金采购，以现货价格从小型矿商处收购黄金，有时还支付溢价。加纳黄金局就其服务收取费用，而央行则负责为采购提供资金并承担相关损失。加纳央行2025年财务报表显示，国内黄金采购计划造成约225亿加纳塞地（GH¢）的亏损。JoyNews Research随后查明亏损的多个来源，包括服务费和检测费、出售给收购方的黄金折价，以及汇率差异。其分析凸显了黄金收购所采用的外汇兑换商汇率与央行会计核算所采用的参考汇率之间的差距。部分亏损反映的是估值影响，而非直接经济成本，但仍削弱了加纳央行的资产负债表。据政府称，加纳黄金局于2026年4月1日开始采购合质金。7月签署的一份备忘录正式确认了该项目从加纳央行移交。实际上，此次移交减轻了中央银行承担的财务负担，但并未自动降低底层交易成本。拟议折扣如今直接针对采购价格本身。以更低价格购入黄金，可能为覆盖精炼、运输、融资及其他交易成本创造更大空间，也可能减少政府为支持该计划所需拨付的资金。政府自身设定的目标表明，这项折扣将降低而非消除该计划成本。即使完成拟议调整，预算仍预计会有2%的剩余成本。政府还必须在降低收购成本与维持官方收购体系对矿商和交易商吸引力之间取得平衡。更低的收购价格可能改善该计划的财务状况，但它对通过持牌渠道供应的黄金数量的影响，将取决于其他地方可获得的价格和付款条件。预算称，政府将与行业利益相关方共同制定这项措施，并特别呼吁加纳全国小型矿工协会和持牌黄金买家协会支持改革。政府继续强调该计划的广泛效益。预算报告称，自2026年1月以来，加纳黄金局已出口88吨小规模黄金，价值120亿美元，为外汇供应、储备积累和塞地提供支持。这些效益解释了政府为何仍重视该计划，也意味着必须透明报告其成本。3%的折扣是针对收购成本问题采取的具体措施。但是，将该计划的融资责任从加纳央行移交给财政部，本身并不能解决这些交易的根本经济问题……

Huang stepped down from Nvidia, one of the major engines behind the AI boom, after reports of a romantic relationship with a businesswoman named Alice Huang whom U.S. authorities suspect of spying for the Chinese government. In addition, a growing number of lawmakers have criticized Lutnick for the administration's refusal to add dozens of Chinese companies to a key U.S. trade blacklist, and over whether the government was properly overseeing Nvidia's exports to China. "Recent reports raise serious concerns about our national security and the protection of sensitive U.S. technology," Scott wrote on X. "I am requesting that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick testify before the Senate Banking Committee." Jensen Huang (L) and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick at the White House in July 2026. Photo by Reuters Spokespeople for Huang and Lutnick could not immediately be reached. Scott said he would consider subpoenaing Huang if he does not voluntarily appear. "The American people deserve answers," Scott said. Senior White House officials were separately discussing whether Lutnick should be pushed out, two people familiar with the situation said, as the desire to take action rose across Washington. Separately, the chairs of three House committees, including the head of the Foreign Affairs panel, Brian Mast, wrote to Huang and Nvidia General Counsel Tim Teter, requiring them to appear for closed-door transcribed interviews on Dec. 1 and 2, respectively, or face subpoenas to compel their appearances. "There are clear national security concerns that need to be addressed immediately," Mast, as well as House China Select Committee Chair John Moolenaar and House Intelligence Committee Chair Rick Crawford, wrote in the letter. They also asked Under Secretary of Commerce Jeffrey Kessler to testify at a Dec. 3 hearing. 美国参议院银行委员会主席Tim Scott于周四致函商务部长Howard Lutnick和Nvidia前首席执行官黄仁勋，要求他们就公司近期 developments 出庭作证。黄仁勋已从Nvidia卸任；该公司是人工智能热潮背后的主要推动力量之一。此前有报道称，他与一名名叫Alice Huang的女商人存在浪漫关系，美国当局怀疑她为中国政府从事间谍活动。

此外，越来越多议员批评Lutnick，指责本届政府拒绝将数十家中国企业列入美国一份关键贸易黑名单，并质疑政府是否妥善监管Nvidia对华出口。

Scott在X上写道：“最近的报道引发了有关我国国家安全以及保护美国敏感技术的严重关切。我要求Nvidia首席执行官黄仁勋和商务部长Howard Lutnick到参议院银行委员会作证。”

2026年7月，黄仁勋（左）和商务部长Howard Lutnick在白宫。Reuters摄影

记者暂时无法联系到黄仁勋和Lutnick的发言人。Scott表示，如果黄仁勋不主动出席，他将继续考虑传唤他。

Scott说：“美国人民有权得到答案。”

两名知情人士表示，随着华盛顿要求采取行动的呼声日益高涨，白宫高级官员正另行讨论是否应迫使Lutnick离职。

此外，众议院三个委员会的主席——其中包括外交事务委员会主席Brian Mast——分别致函黄仁勋和Nvidia总法律顾问Tim Teter，要求他们于12月1日和2日分别出席闭门且有文字记录的访谈，否则将收到强制其出席的传票。

Mast、众议院中国特别委员会主席John Moolenaar以及众议院情报委员会主席Rick Crawford在信中写道：“目前存在一些需要立即处理的明确国家安全问题。”

他们还要求商务部副部长Jeffrey Kessler在12月3日的听证会上作证。

中国方面否认Alice Huang是间谍。美国总检察长Todd Blanche周四表示，司法部尚未就是否为她间谍作出结论。记者未能联系到Alice Huang置评

https://punchng.com/seplat-fixes-q3-divi.body: Seplat Energy Plc has announced the applicable foreign exchange rate for calculating the naira equivalent of its third-quarter 2026 interim and special dividends. In a corporate disclosure issued on Thursday from its offices in Lagos and London, the dual-listed energy company confirmed that shareholders who elected to receive their payouts in naira, or whose default currency is naira, will have their dividends converted at a rate of N1,358.34 to one United States dollar. According to the statement signed by Chief Financial Officer Eleanor Adaralegbe, the conversion figure aligns with Seplat Energy’s established dividend payment procedures and reflects the Nigerian Foreign Exchange Market rate published by the Central Bank of Nigeria on 11 November 2026. The company advised shareholders seeking clarity on default currency rules to consult its earlier regulatory announcement published on 29 October 2026, via its corporate website. The exchange rate disclosure follows Seplat Energy’s strong operational and financial performance for the nine months ended 30 September 2026, which prompted the board to declare a combined Q3 payout comprising an interim dividend and a special dividend. That distribution was underpinned by growth in revenue and free cash flow amid higher onshore and offshore production, with the qualification and record date closing on 12 November 2026, ahead of electronic dividend disbursement scheduled for on or around 27 November 2026. Seplat Energy, which trades on the Premium Board of the Nigerian Exchange Limited and the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange, “is Nigeria’s leading indigenous energy company” and operates a broad portfolio of onshore and shallow-water assets across the Niger Delta, alongside three gas processing plants and interests in three export terminals.
